Argon for ion engines, a cheaper stand-in for xenon at the cost of slightly lower efficiency. Where an atmosphere carries it at all it tends to be sparse, so gathering a useful amount takes a dedicated scoop and some patience.
当前中文: 用于离子发动机的氩气，是氙气的廉价替代品，代价是效率略低。大气中即便含有氩气也往往十分稀薄，要采集到可用的量需要专用采集器和一些耐心。

英文原文: Battery is used to power many components of a craft, and unlike fuel, it can be regenerated.
当前中文: 电池为载具的许多部件供电，与燃料不同，它可以重新充能。

英文原文: Methane for use as the fuel component in Methalox rocket engines. It turns up as atmospheric gas, surface ice, and even liquid lakes, so a harvester can often top up in the field. Store alongside an Oxygen tank and the engine will burn them together when the combined Methalox mixture tank is depleted.
当前中文: 用作甲烷氧火箭发动机燃料组分的甲烷。它以大气气体、地表冰甚至液体湖泊的形式出现，因此采集器常能在野外就地补充。与氧气箱一同存放，混合甲烷氧燃料箱耗尽后发动机便会同时燃烧两者。

英文原文: Carbon dioxide, harvested from the atmosphere where a world has one or mined from frozen surface deposits. On its own it's just cargo, but feed it to a Sabatier converter with some hydrogen and it becomes methane fuel.
当前中文: 二氧化碳，可从有大气层的天体大气中采集，或从地表冻结沉积物中开采。它本身只是货物，但把它和一些氢气送入萨巴蒂尔转化器，就能变成甲烷燃料。

英文原文: Now that's what I call high-quality H2O.
当前中文: 这才是我说的高品质 H2O。

英文原文: A storable monopropellant that runs without a separate oxidizer, handy for RCS and small thrusters. It's less efficient than hydrazine, but you can make it from nothing but water, so it's the easy choice for a self-sufficient base.
当前中文: 可长期储存的单组元推进剂，无需单独的氧化剂即可工作，适合 RCS 和小型推进器。效率不如肼，但它仅用水就能制取，因此是自给自足基地的省心之选。

英文原文: Special kerosene for use in jet engines. Note: Jet engines don't need to be directly connected to fuel tanks with jet fuel. As long as your craft has some, they will work.
当前中文: 用于喷气发动机的专用煤油。注意：喷气发动机不必与装有喷气燃料的燃料箱直接相连，只要载具上有这种燃料，它们就能工作。

英文原文: It's for jetpacks...also this shouldn't be showing up anywhere.
当前中文: 这是给喷气背包用的……而且它本不该出现在任何地方。

英文原文: Hydrogen for use in rocket engines. Without an oxidizer it is even more efficient, but can then only be used in nuclear rocket engines. Also serves as the fuel component for Hydrolox engines when stored alongside Oxygen tanks, and a scoop can harvest it from any atmosphere rich enough in it.
当前中文: 用于火箭发动机的氢气。不加氧化剂时效率更高，但那样只能用于核火箭发动机。与氧气箱一同存放时也作为氢氧发动机的燃料组分，采集器可以从任何富含氢气的大气中收集它。

英文原文: Oxygen for use as the oxidizer component in bipropellant rocket engines. Cryogenic in storage, but a scoop can pull it straight from an atmosphere that carries it. Store alongside a compatible fuel (Kerosene, Hydrogen, or Methane) and the engine will burn them together when the combined mixture tank is depleted.
当前中文: 用作双组元火箭发动机氧化剂组分的氧气。储存时需低温保存，但采集器可以直接从含氧大气中提取。与兼容的燃料（煤油、氢气或甲烷）一同存放，混合燃料箱耗尽后发动机便会同时燃烧两者。

英文原文: Oxygen and methane for use in rocket engines. Somewhat more efficient than kerolox, but easier to work with than hydrolox.
当前中文: 用于火箭发动机的氧气和甲烷。效率比煤油氧略高，但比氢氧更易操作。

英文原文: Oxygen and hydrogen for use in rocket engines. Hydrolox is very efficient, but it has extremely low density and therefore requires larger fuel tanks.
当前中文: 用于火箭发动机的氧气和氢气。氢氧效率很高，但密度极低，因此需要更大的燃料箱。

英文原文: Oxygen and kerosene for use in rocket engines. It's cheap and only moderately cryogenic so it's safer and easier to work with. The downside is that it's not as efficient as some of the other fuels.
当前中文: 用于火箭发动机的氧气和煤油。它价格低廉，低温要求不高，因此更安全、更易操作。缺点是效率不如其他一些燃料。

英文原文: Toxic? Maybe. But its flexibility is perfect for RCS and simple engines. If you smell ammonia, run.
当前中文: 有毒？也许吧。但它灵活多用，非常适合 RCS 和简单发动机。如果你闻到氨味，快跑。

英文原文: Nitrogen, scooped from the atmosphere of any world that has one. Nothing burns it directly, but combine it with hydrogen in a converter and you can synthesize hydrazine, a potent storable propellant.
当前中文: 氮气，可从任何有大气层的天体大气中采集。没有东西会直接燃烧它，但在转化器中与氢气结合，就能合成肼——一种强力的可储存推进剂。

英文原文: Only for those who dare to play with fire, watch for your fingers.
当前中文: 只适合敢玩火的人，小心你的手指。

英文原文: Highly refined kerosene (RP-1) for use as the fuel component in Kerolox rocket engines. Store alongside an Oxygen tank and the engine will burn them together when the combined Kerolox mixture tank is depleted.
当前中文: 高纯度精炼煤油（RP-1），用作煤油氧火箭发动机的燃料组分。与氧气箱一同存放，混合煤油氧燃料箱耗尽后发动机便会同时燃烧两者。

英文原文: Loose surface rock and dust, drilled straight from the ground. No engine burns it and no converter processes it, but with a drill and a tank you can haul it back from anywhere you can land.
当前中文: 松散的表面岩石与尘土，直接从地面钻取。没有发动机会燃烧它，也没有转化器能处理它，但只要带上钻头和燃料箱，你就能从任何能着陆的地方把它运回来。

英文原文: Solid fuel for use in rocket engines. It packs a lot of impulse into a small space, but it is heavy and expensive.
当前中文: 用于火箭发动机的固体燃料。它能在很小的体积内提供很大的冲量，但既重又贵。

英文原文: Xenon is used by ion engines. It's an inert gas, so it won't cause huge explosions. Depending on what you're going for that might be a good thing or a bad thing.
当前中文: 氙气供离子发动机使用。它是惰性气体，不会造成大爆炸。这算好事还是坏事，取决于你想要什么。

当前中文: Unity 的渐变最多只支持 8 个 {0} 键。

Build a rocket that can reach an altitude of 100km above sea level.
当前中文: 建造一枚能飞至海平面以上 100 公里的火箭。

英文原文: I can show you how to build a rocket. It'll take only about 10 minutes, but the knowledge will last a lifetime! It'll be fun!
当前中文: 我可以教你如何建造火箭。只要大约 10 分钟，但学到的知识受用一生！会很有趣的！

英文原文: Practice docking with a satellite. Just ease forward and give the satellite a little kiss with your docking port. Once at close range, the docking port applies a small magnetic force to help align the two ports together.
当前中文: 练习与卫星对接。缓缓前进，用你的对接口轻吻一下卫星。进入近距离后，对接口会施加微小的磁力，帮助两个接口对齐。

英文原文: The European Space Agency is visiting Jupiter for the first time with the JUpiter ICy moons Explorer.\n\nTo commemorate this, can you bring JUICE to Tydos? Fuel is low, so you may need some Gravity Assists. Keep your deltaV usage as low as possible!
当前中文: 欧洲空间局首次携木星冰月探测器造访木星。\n\n为纪念此事，你能把 JUICE 带到 Tydos 吗？燃料不多，可能需要借助引力助推。请尽量降低 deltaV 消耗！

英文原文: Launch from Droo and reach escape velocity so your orbit becomes hyperbolic. The level ends once you leave Droo's Sphere of Influence (SOI). You must use less than 60kL of fuel to win.
当前中文: 从 Droo 发射并达到逃逸速度，使轨道变为双曲线。一旦离开 Droo 的影响范围（SOI），关卡即结束。燃料消耗须少于 60kL 才能获胜。

英文原文: I can show you how to fly the rocket from the Designer Tutorial. All the way from blast-off to orbit.
当前中文: 我可以教你如何驾驶设计器教程中造出的火箭，从点火升空一直到进入轨道。

英文原文: Practice landing on Luna. It's not an easy thing to do, so this is a great place to learn some technique.
当前中文: 在 Luna 上练习着陆。这并不简单，因此是学习技巧的好地方。

英文原文: Fly your rocket as far as you can without going above 5,000 meters or touching the ground. You must fly more than 50km to pass. Don't worry about landing safely; just go far and do a spectacular crash landing.
当前中文: 让你的火箭飞得尽可能远，但不得高于 5000 米，也不能触地。飞行距离必须超过 50 公里才能通过。不必担心安全着陆；飞得远、摔得壮观就好。

英文原文: Get into a low orbit around Droo. Your periapsis must be at least 100km and you must use less than 10kL of fuel.
当前中文: 进入 Droo 的低轨道。近拱点至少 100 公里，且燃料消耗须少于 10kL。

英文原文: How fast can you go? You have 20 days to reach the maximum speed possible. Exceed 30,000m/s to win. Speed is calculated relative to the body you're orbiting.\n\nTip: Sometimes you have to slow down to speed up! Also, if you're using more than 25-30 engines, you're not doing it right!
当前中文: 你能跑多快？你有 20 天时间达到尽可能高的速度。超过 30,000 米/秒即可获胜。速度是相对于你所环绕的天体计算的。\n\n提示：有时必须减速才能加速！另外，如果你用了超过 25-30 台发动机，说明方法不对！

英文原文: Build a rocket that exceeds 750m/s before reaching 2km above ground level. You must fly straight up. Drift sideways more than 100 meters and you fail this challenge.
当前中文: 建造一枚在离地 2 公里前速度超过 750 米/秒的火箭。必须垂直上升。横向偏移超过 100 米即挑战失败。

英文原文: Get into medium orbit around Droo. At least 5,000km periapsis. You must use less than 200 kL of fuel.
当前中文: 进入 Droo 的中轨道。近拱点至少 5000 公里。燃料消耗须少于 200 kL。

英文原文: Land on Luna using as little fuel as possible. Apollo 11 did this back in 1969 with an on-board computer less powerful than your phone, so this should be easy, right?\n\nYou must use less than 50kL of fuel to win.
当前中文: 用尽可能少的燃料在 Luna 上着陆。1969 年阿波罗 11 号用一台还不如你手机强大的机载计算机就做到了，所以这应该很简单，对吧？\n\n燃料消耗须少于 50kL 才能获胜。

英文原文: I hope you like a challenge. Blast off from Droo, make your way to Luna, and reach a stable orbit around it using less than 50kL of fuel. Your Periapsis must be at least 25km for the orbit to count.
当前中文: 希望你喜欢挑战。从 Droo 发射，飞向 Luna，并用少于 50kL 的燃料进入环绕它的稳定轨道。近拱点至少 25 公里，轨道才算数。

英文原文: Get to Luna as fast as you can. Don't worry about landing. The timer stops whenever you smash into Luna's surface. You have 10 hours to accomplish your mission. Good luck!
当前中文: 以最快速度抵达 Luna。不必考虑着陆。当你撞上 Luna 表面时计时停止。你有 10 小时完成任务。祝好运！

英文原文: You're given a small rocket with very little fuel and must fly it as far as you can. You must travel at least 15km to win.\n\nTip: Atmospheric drag can really slow you down, but it decreases quickly as you gain altitude.
当前中文: 你得到一枚燃料极少的小火箭，要把它飞得尽可能远。至少飞行 15 公里才能获胜。\n\n提示：大气阻力会让你明显减速，但它会随着高度增加迅速减小。

英文原文:
Starting in orbit around Droo with a small rocket, you must make your way back to Droo and parachute safely to the ground.

Do a retrograde burn to bring your orbit into the atmosphere, then land safely.

Beware of part damage from excessive heat during re-entry.
当前中文:
驾驶一枚小火箭从环绕 Droo 的轨道出发，返回 Droo 并用降落伞安全落地。

进行逆航向点火，让轨道进入大气层，然后安全着陆。

小心再入时高温对零件造成损伤。

英文原文: Get into orbit around Droo. Your periapsis must be at least 250km and your inclination between 85 and 95 degrees. You must use less than 50 kL of fuel.
当前中文: 进入环绕 Droo 的轨道。近拱点至少 250 公里，倾角在 85 到 95 度之间。燃料消耗须少于 50 kL。

英文原文: Build a rocket, launch from Droo, and rendezvous with the satellite already in orbit. This is an extremely challenging endeavor, far harder than Luna Landing.
当前中文: 建造一枚火箭，从 Droo 发射，与已在轨道上的卫星交会。这是极具挑战的任务，比 Luna 着陆难得多。

英文原文: You need a docking port to dock with the satellite!
当前中文: 你需要一个对接口才能与卫星对接！

英文原文: Our shuttle was coming in for a landing when we remembered we don't know how to pilot a space shuttle...\n\n Would you please lend us a hand?
当前中文: 我们的航天飞机正准备着陆时，我们才想起自己不会驾驶航天飞机……\n\n能请你帮个忙吗？

英文原文: See how quickly you can orbit Droo. Your Periapsis must be at least 100km for the orbit to count. You have 5 minutes from launch.
当前中文: 看看你能多快环绕 Droo。近拱点至少 100 公里，轨道才算数。从发射起你有 5 分钟。

英文原文:
Play the career contract tutorial 'Like a Bird'.

This tutorial covers the basics of building and flying airplanes with a very simple glider.

Contract Description:
You've already tried to jump as far as possible from the runway; now you have to take off from it. Be wise and get some wings, or yolo it and find an alternative, you do you.
当前中文:
游玩生涯合约教程「像鸟一样」。

本教程通过一架很简单的滑翔机，讲解建造和驾驶飞机的基础知识。

合约描述：
你已经在跑道上试过尽可能远地跳跃了；现在你得从跑道上起飞。明智点是装上机翼，或者大胆试试别的办法，随你。

英文原文:
Play the career contract tutorial 'Droo Orbit'.

This tutorial covers staging analysis and tuning rocket engine performance in the designer, followed by a guided tutorial to achieve orbit around Droo.

Contract Description:
Can you go to orbit? I need you near specific orbits and I know you can get there. First, reach any orbit to prove yourself.
当前中文:
游玩生涯合约教程「Droo 轨道」。

本教程讲解设计器中的分级分析和火箭发动机性能调校，随后是一段引导教程，带你进入环绕 Droo 的轨道。

合约描述：
你能进入轨道吗？我需要你待在特定轨道附近，我知道你做得到。先进入任意轨道来证明自己吧。

英文原文:
Play the career contract tutorial 'Going High'.

This tutorial covers the basics of staging and payloads.

Contract Description:
Droo's atmosphere ends right under 80km. Can you go to space to expose a probe a scientist sent me?
当前中文:
游玩生涯合约教程「飞向高空」。

本教程讲解分级和载荷的基础知识。

合约描述：
Droo 的大气层在 80 公里稍下处结束。你能上太空去把一位科学家寄给我的探测器暴露一下吗？

英文原文:
Play the career contract tutorial 'Learning To Fly'.

This tutorial guides you through a simple route to practice take off and landing.

Contract Description:
This is a time trial for planes, so get your gloves tight! Go through all checkpoints in order before time runs out.
当前中文:
游玩生涯合约教程「学飞」。

本教程带你沿一条简单航线练习起飞和着陆。

合约描述：
这是专为飞机准备的计时赛，系好你的手套！在时间耗尽前按顺序通过所有检查点。

英文原文:
Play the career contract tutorial 'The Jump'.

This tutorial teaches the basics of building and driving a very simple wheeled ground vehicle.

Contract Description:
One advantage of a huge ramp on a cliff's edge is you can fly without much effort. Go airborne for more than 150m after jumping from the end of the runway.
当前中文:
游玩生涯合约教程「跳跃」。

本教程教授建造和驾驶一辆很简单的轮式地面载具的基础知识。

合约描述：
悬崖边有一个巨大的坡道，好处之一就是不费什么力气就能飞起来。从跑道末端起跳后，要在空中飞行超过 150 米。

英文原文:
Play the career contract tutorial 'Vertical Shot'.

This tutorial teaches the basics of building and launching a simple rocket, and briefly covers the flight user interface.

Contract Description:
When you send your fireworks high enough, hitting a house in the village can become a huge problem, but going too far makes finding the scraps annoying. Crash no further than 20km, but no closer than 500m from the launchpad.
当前中文:
游玩生涯合约教程「垂直发射」。

本教程教授建造和发射一枚简单火箭的基础知识，并简要介绍飞行界面。

合约描述：
当你的烟花放得够高时，砸到村里的房子就会变成大麻烦，但飞得太远又会让残骸难以寻找。坠毁点距发射台不超过 20 公里，也不少于 500 米。

英文原文: Defines detached cloud layers that are rendered on dedicated transparent spheres around the planet in scaled space. Each layer reads its density from a data slot produced by the planet generation modifiers, and has its own height, tint and rotation speed. Order the layers by altitude (Low has the smallest height, High the largest) so higher layers correctly shadow the ones below them. The fourth layer is a non-rotating mask that multiplies the opacity of the other layers.
当前中文: 定义在缩放空间中渲染于行星周围专用透明球面上的独立云层。每个云层从行星生成修改器产生的数据槽读取密度，并拥有各自的高度、色调和旋转速度。请按高度排列云层（低层高度最小，高层最大），以便较高层正确遮蔽其下方的云层。第四层是不旋转的遮罩，用于乘算其他层的不透明度。

英文原文: How finely the close-up detail noise tiles on this layer in the ground-level cloud view (higher is finer). Has no effect on the view from space.
当前中文: 在地面云层视图中，此层近景细节噪声的平铺精细程度（越高越精细）。对太空视角无影响。

英文原文: Multiplies this layer's rotation speed to set how fast its close-up detail drifts and rotates in the ground-level cloud view. Has no effect on the view from space.
当前中文: 乘算此层的旋转速度，决定地面云层视图中其近景细节漂移和旋转的快慢。对太空视角无影响。

英文原文: How strongly the close-up detail noise erodes this layer's edges in the ground-level cloud view (0 to ~0.6). Has no effect on the view from space.
当前中文: 在地面云层视图中，近景细节噪声侵蚀此层边缘的强度（0 至约 0.6）。对太空视角无影响。

英文原文: The height of the cloud layer above sea level, in meters.
当前中文: 云层高于海平面的高度，单位为米。

英文原文: The data slot (produced by the planet generation modifiers) that this layer reads its density from. Set to -1 to disable the layer.
当前中文: 此层读取密度的数据槽（由行星生成修改器产生）。设为 -1 可禁用该层。

英文原文: The data slot for a non-rotating mask that multiplies the opacity of the cloud layers, so clouds can be confined to certain regions. Set to -1 to disable.
当前中文: 不旋转遮罩的数据槽，该遮罩乘算云层的不透明度，从而可将云限制在特定区域。设为 -1 可禁用。

英文原文: How strongly the mask layer affects this layer's opacity (0 = ignore the mask, 1 = fully masked). Use low values for high clouds and high values for fog.
当前中文: 遮罩层影响此层不透明度的强度（0 = 忽略遮罩，1 = 完全受遮罩）。高层云用低值，雾用高值。

英文原文: The rotation speed of the layer in radians per second, applied in addition to the planet's own rotation.
当前中文: 此层的旋转速度，单位为弧度/秒，在行星自身旋转之外额外施加。

英文原文: Reduces the cloud mask based on the planet's position in its orbit for a seasonal effect (0 disables it). Negative values thin the clouds most at the closest point to the parent (periapsis) and least at the farthest (apoapsis); positive values do the reverse. Only affects planets that use a cloud mask.
当前中文: 根据行星在轨道上的位置削减云层遮罩，以产生季节效果（0 表示禁用）。负值在距离母天体最近处（近拱点）云最稀薄，最远处（远拱点）最厚；正值则相反。仅影响使用云层遮罩的行星。

英文原文: How strongly this layer follows the terrain height, lifting it over high ground so low clouds do not clip into elevated terrain (0 = flat shell, 1 = fully follows the terrain).
当前中文: 此层贴合地形高度的强度，在高地上抬高云层，使低云不会穿入较高的地形（0 = 平坦球壳，1 = 完全贴合地形）。

英文原文: The thickness of the cloud layer in meters, giving it a visible vertical extent when flying through it in the ground-level cloud view. Has no effect on the view from space.
当前中文: 云层的厚度，单位为米，在地面云层视图中穿行时呈现可见的垂直厚度。对太空视角无影响。

英文原文: The color of the clouds. The alpha channel acts as an overall opacity multiplier.
当前中文: 云的颜色。alpha 通道作为整体的不透明度乘数。

英文原文: The input data value which identifies which color band(s) will be used. For gas giants, this is typically the y-coordinate on a Unit sphere.
当前中文: 用于确定使用哪些色带的输入数据值。对于气态巨行星，通常是单位球面上的 y 坐标。

英文原文: A planet modifier that produces color bands based on a data value.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，根据数据值生成色带。

英文原文: The maximum expected input value. With the minimum, this sets the expected range of the input data value to remap it into the zero-to-one range.
当前中文: 预期的最大输入值。与最小值一起设定输入数据值的预期范围，以便将其重映射到 0 到 1 区间。

英文原文: The minimum expected input value. Used with the maximum to determine the input data's expected range and remap it into the zero-to-one range.
当前中文: 预期的最小输入值。与最大值一起确定输入数据的预期范围，并将其重映射到 0 到 1 区间。

英文原文: The color value to be blended in to the existing color.
当前中文: 要混合到现有颜色中的颜色值。

英文原文: An optional input specifying a data value to use as the source alpha channel, instead of the alpha defined in the source color.
当前中文: 可选输入，指定一个数据值作为源透明度通道，替代源颜色中定义的透明度。

英文原文: A planet modifier that blends two colors together based on a data value.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，根据数据值混合两种颜色。

英文原文: The blend type used for the destination color (the existing color before this modifier is applied). This essentially selects the value by which the destination color will be multiplied.
当前中文: 用于目标颜色（应用此修改器之前的现有颜色）的混合类型。这实质上是选择目标颜色将乘算的值。

英文原文: The blend type used for the source color (specified in this modifier). This is essentially selecting the value by which the source color will be multiplied.
当前中文: 用于源颜色（在此修改器中指定）的混合类型。这实质上是选择源颜色将乘算的值。

英文原文: The inner angle (in degrees) based on a vector through the center of the pole.
当前中文: 内角（单位：度），基于穿过极点中心的向量。

英文原文: The output value (before noise and remapping) that is used leading up to and including the inner angle.
当前中文: 在达到并包括内角之前所使用的输出值（噪声和重映射之前）。

英文原文: The outer angle (in degrees) based on a vector through the center of the pole.
当前中文: 外角（单位：度），基于穿过极点中心的向量。

英文原文: The output value (before noise and remapping) that is used at the outer angle and beyond.
当前中文: 在外角及其之外所使用的输出值（噪声和重映射之前）。

英文原文: The input data value that provides noise to the polar cap mask.
当前中文: 为极冠遮罩提供噪声的输入数据值。

英文原文: If enabled, the linear remapping will be clamped in the range of zero to one. If disabled, output values could exceed the zero to one range.
当前中文: 启用后，线性重映射将被限制在 0 到 1 区间。禁用后，输出值可能超出 0 到 1 区间。

英文原文: The maximum value used to remap the output value in the range of zero to one.
当前中文: 用于将输出值重映射到 0 到 1 区间的最大值。

英文原文: The minimum value used to remap the output value in the range of zero to one.
当前中文: 用于将输出值重映射到 0 到 1 区间的最小值。

英文原文: The noise strength that is used leading up to and including the inner angle.
当前中文: 在达到并包括内角之前所使用的噪声强度。

英文原文: The noise strength that is used at the outer angle and beyond.
当前中文: 在外角及其之外所使用的噪声强度。

英文原文: This provides an easy way to quickly disable a crater pass, which can be useful in development and testing.
当前中文: 提供一种快速禁用某个陨石坑通道的便捷方式，在开发和测试中很有用。

英文原文: The frequency of the noise that generates the craters. The higher the frequency the smaller and more numerous the craters become.
当前中文: 生成陨石坑的噪声频率。频率越高，坑越小、数量越多。

英文原文: The maximum depth of the crater in meters. This occurs when the crater shape curve evaluates to -1 on the y-axis.
当前中文: 陨石坑的最大深度，单位为米。当坑形曲线在 y 轴上的求值为 -1 时达到该深度。

英文原文: The value used to linearly interpolate the crater shape noise between data inputs 'A' and 'B'. At 0, only input 'A' provides noise to the crater shapes. At 1, only input 'B' is used. Any value between 0 and 1 interpolates between the two.
当前中文: 用于在数据输入「A」和「B」之间线性插值坑形噪声的值。为 0 时，只有输入「A」为坑形提供噪声。为 1 时，只用输入「B」。0 到 1 之间的任意值则在两者之间插值。

英文原文: The scalar value used to adjust the strength of the crater shape noise before it is applied.
当前中文: 在应用之前用于调整坑形噪声强度的标量值。

英文原文: The randomness in the crater position noise. Less randomness means more consistent (and larger) craters but they will be more grid like in alignment.
当前中文: 陨石坑位置噪声中的随机度。随机度越低，坑更一致（也更大），但排列会更接近网格。

英文原文: The rotation angle applied to the input position used to sample crater positions and sizes. Sometimes adjusting it slightly helps when multiple passes all want to pile craters on top of each other.
当前中文: 对用于采样坑位置和大小的输入位置施加的旋转角度。当多个通道都想把坑堆在同一处时，略微调整它会有所帮助。

英文原文: The axis of the rotation angle applied to the input position used to sample crater positions and sizes. Sometimes adjusting the rotation slightly helps when multiple passes all want to pile craters on top of each other.
当前中文: 对用于采样坑位置和大小的输入位置所施加旋转角度的轴。当多个通道都想把坑堆在同一处时，略微调整旋转会有所帮助。

英文原文: The seed value used for the cellular noise that generates the crater positions and sizes.
当前中文: 用于生成陨石坑位置和大小的蜂窝噪声的种子值。

英文原文: The curve that craters resemble. Typically mapped between (0,-1) and (1,0). The x-axis is distance from the crater center, the y-axis is crater depth. The left side, starting at 0, is the crater center; the right side, typically ending at 1, is the end of the crater rims. The bottom, starting at -1, is the deepest part; the top, ending at 0, is the planet's regular surface.
当前中文: 陨石坑所遵循的曲线。通常映射在 (0,-1) 到 (1,0) 之间。x 轴是到坑中心的距离，y 轴是坑的深度。左侧从 0 开始，是坑中心；右侧通常到 1 结束，是坑缘的末端。底部从 -1 开始，是最深处；顶部到 0 结束，是行星的常规表面。

英文原文: The frequency of the noise that generates the crater positions and sizes. The higher the frequency, the smaller and more numerous the craters become.
当前中文: 生成陨石坑位置和大小的噪声频率。频率越高，坑越小、数量越多。

英文原文: The data input that, if used, can mask out the craters this modifier generates. Typically a value between zero and one, where one means full-strength unmasked craters and zero means this modifier changes nothing.
当前中文: 可选使用的数据输入，可遮除此修改器生成的陨石坑。通常为 0 到 1 之间的值，1 表示全强度、不被遮除的坑，0 表示此修改器不产生任何改变。

英文原文: The exponent applied to the crater positional noise. This is used to help prevent seams between craters.
当前中文: 施加到坑位置噪声的指数。用于帮助防止陨石坑之间出现接缝。

英文原文: The strength of the crater shape noise. This noise adds variation to crater shapes so they aren't perfectly circular. The crater shape noise is highly configurable, and this value provides an easy way to adjust its final strength.
当前中文: 坑形噪声的强度。该噪声为坑形增加变化，使它们不是完美的圆形。坑形噪声可高度配置，而此值提供了一种便捷方式，用于调整其最终强度。

英文原文: The number of crater passes to perform. Crater passes are expensive, so use them sparingly; however, multiple crater passes are cheaper than the same number of single-pass crater modifiers for a similar effect. Craters within a pass can't overlap, but craters in different passes can.
当前中文: 要执行的陨石坑通道数量。坑通道开销很大，请谨慎使用；不过，要达到类似效果，多通道的坑比同样数量的单通道坑修改器更省性能。同一通道内的坑不能重叠，不同通道的坑可以重叠。

英文原文: A planet modifier that generates terrain crater features.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，生成地形陨石坑特征。

英文原文: The data output that, if used, holds the summed crater height noise from all passes. Multiplied by the crater max depth and the final crater strength, it gives the final height adjustment this modifier applies. Not always useful, but it can be. For example, with a single-pass crater, this value can pinpoint where craters are, so you can feed it into a biome modifier to generate biomes inside and outside craters.
当前中文: 可选使用的数据输出，保存所有通道的坑高度噪声总和。乘以坑最大深度和最终坑强度，即为该修改器施加的最终高度调整。它并非总是有用，但有时确实有用。例如，对于单通道陨石坑，此值可以精确定位坑的位置，因此你可以将它接入生物群系修改器，在坑内外生成生物群系。

英文原文: The red, green, and blue color values (0 to 1) to add to the terrain color as the crater extends above the planet's surface. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to the crater rims.
当前中文: 当坑高出行星表面时，添加到地形颜色的红、绿、蓝颜色值（0 到 1）。可为坑缘增加一点颜色变化。

英文原文: The red, green, and blue color values (0 to 1) to subtract from the terrain color as it reaches the craters' minimum height. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to the deep centers of craters.
当前中文: 当达到坑的最低高度时，从地形颜色中减去的红、绿、蓝颜色值（0 到 1）。可为坑的深处中心增加一点颜色变化。

英文原文: The first crater shape noise input data. Each crater pass can choose a value by which this noise input and the other are linearly interpolated to generate that pass's crater shape noise value. This adds variation so craters don't all appear as perfect circles. Lower frequency noise (relative to the crater size) can create some very interesting non-crater-like terrain.
当前中文: 第一个坑形噪声输入数据。每个坑通道可选择一个值，用于将此噪声输入与另一个输入线性插值，以生成该通道的坑形噪声值。这增加了变化，使坑不都呈现为完美的圆形。较低的频率（相对于坑的大小）可以造出一些非常有趣、不像坑的地形。

英文原文: The second crater shape noise input. Each crater pass picks a value used to linearly interpolate this noise input and the other to generate that pass's crater shape noise. This noise adds variation so craters don't all look like perfect circles. Lower frequency noise (relative to crater size) can create some very interesting non-crater-like terrain.
当前中文: 第二个坑形噪声输入。每个坑通道会选取一个值，用于将此噪声输入与另一个输入线性插值，以生成该通道的坑形噪声。该噪声增加了变化，使坑不都看起来像完美的圆形。较低的频率（相对于坑的大小）可以造出一些非常有趣、不像坑的地形。

英文原文: The default curve that craters resemble. Individual passes can override this; passes without a custom curve fall back to it. Typically mapped between (0,-1) and (1,0). The x-axis is distance from the crater center, the y-axis is crater depth. The left side, starting at 0, is the crater center; the right side, typically ending at 1, is the end of the crater rims. The bottom, starting at -1, is the deepest part; the top, ending at 0, is the planet's regular surface.
当前中文: 陨石坑默认遵循的曲线。各通道可覆盖此项；没有自定义曲线的通道则回退到它。通常映射在 (0,-1) 到 (1,0) 之间。x 轴是到坑中心的距离，y 轴是坑的深度。左侧从 0 开始，是坑中心；右侧通常到 1 结束，是坑缘的末端。底部从 -1 开始，是最深处；顶部到 0 结束，是行星的常规表面。

英文原文: A fast planet modifier that generates terrain crater features.
当前中文: 一种快速行星修改器，生成地形陨石坑特征。

英文原文: An optional data output that stores the minimum noise output used for the height of the craters.
当前中文: 可选数据输出，保存用于坑高度的最小噪声输出。

英文原文: Prevents the seed from being randomized when the randomize button is clicked.
当前中文: 点击随机化按钮时，防止种子被随机化。

英文原文: The red, green, and blue color values (typically 0 to 1) to add to the terrain color as the crater rises above the planet's surface. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to crater rims.
当前中文: 当坑高出行星表面时，添加到地形颜色的红、绿、蓝颜色值（通常为 0 到 1）。可为坑缘增加一点颜色变化。

英文原文: The red, green, and blue color values (typically 0 to 1) to subtract from the terrain color as it reaches the craters' minimum height. Useful for adding a bit of color variation to the deep centers of craters.
当前中文: 当达到坑的最低高度时，从地形颜色中减去的红、绿、蓝颜色值（通常为 0 到 1）。可为坑的深处中心增加一点颜色变化。

英文原文: Allows multiple, unlocked Noise elements to obtain the same seed when the randomize button is clicked.
当前中文: 允许多个未锁定的噪声元素在点击随机化按钮时获得相同的种子。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads data from a cubemap texture for the celestial body and stores an output value based on that data. The cubemap texture should be in horizontal format (X+, X-, Y+, Y-, Z+, Z-).
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，从天体的立方体贴图读取数据，并根据该数据存储输出值。立方体贴图应为横向格式（X+、X-、Y+、Y-、Z+、Z-）。

英文原文: The interpolation method used when sampling the texture data. Bilinear should be much faster. Bicubic should be smoother, but won't always look better than bilinear, since the look depends heavily on the texture content and resolution. Stick with bilinear for performance unless bicubic offers a far better visual result.
当前中文: 采样贴图数据时所用的插值方式。双线性要快得多。双三次更平滑，但未必总比双线性好看，因为视觉效果很大程度上取决于贴图的内容与分辨率。除非双三次的视觉效果明显更好，否则建议用双线性以保性能。

英文原文: The color gradient used in planet studio when using a brush on this cubemap.
当前中文: 在行星工坊中对此立方体贴图使用画笔时所用的颜色渐变。

英文原文: The cubemap display name associated with this modifier (if any). This is required for using the brush flyout with this cubemap modifier.
当前中文: 与此修改器关联的立方体贴图显示名称（若有）。要在此立方体贴图修改器上使用画笔弹出菜单，必须设置此项。

英文原文: The output value is linearly interpolated between the min and max values based on the texture data's pixel value. This also sets the maximum value of the source data when generating a default cubemap.
当前中文: 输出值根据贴图数据的像素值在最小值与最大值之间线性插值。生成默认立方体贴图时，此项也设定源数据的最大值。

英文原文: The output value is linearly interpolated between the min and max value based on the texture data's pixel value. This also defines the minimum value of the source data when generating a default cubemap.
当前中文: 输出值根据贴图数据的像素值在最小值与最大值之间线性插值。生成默认立方体贴图时，此项也定义源数据的最小值。

英文原文: The bits per pixel used at runtime to represent the texture data. A value of 32 can be slightly more efficient on the CPU but uses far more memory at runtime, especially for large textures. It's recommended to leave this at 8 bits per pixel.
当前中文: 运行时用于表示贴图数据的每像素位数。32 位在 CPU 上可能稍快，但运行时会占用多得多的内存，贴图越大越明显。建议保持 8 位。

英文原文: The texture channel from which values should be used for this texture.
当前中文: 应从此贴图的哪个通道取值。

英文原文: The debug color used to identify the X-negative face of the cubemap.
当前中文: 用于标识立方体贴图 X 负方向面的调试颜色。

英文原文: The debug color used to identify the X-positive face of the cubemap.
当前中文: 用于标识立方体贴图 X 正方向面的调试颜色。

英文原文: The debug color used to identify the Y-negative face of the cubemap.
当前中文: 用于标识立方体贴图 Y 负方向面的调试颜色。

英文原文: The debug color used to identify the Y-positive face of the cubemap.
当前中文: 用于标识立方体贴图 Y 正方向面的调试颜色。

英文原文: The debug color used to identify the Z-negative face of the cubemap.
当前中文: 用于标识立方体贴图 Z 负方向面的调试颜色。

英文原文: The debug color used to identify the Z-positive face of the cubemap.
当前中文: 用于标识立方体贴图 Z 正方向面的调试颜色。

英文原文: A debug planet modifier that visualizes the cubemap faces of the planet.
当前中文: 一种调试用行星修改器，用于可视化行星的立方体贴图各面。
调试可视化（立方体贴图）
调试可视化（立方体贴图）

英文原文: The input data to visualize. This value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values specified by this modifier, then color will be applied based on the specified gradient.
当前中文: 要可视化的输入数据。该值会按此修改器指定的最小值与最大值线性插值，然后依据指定的渐变着色。

英文原文: A debug planet modifier that visualizes a data value on the planet surface.
当前中文: 一种调试用行星修改器，用于在行星表面可视化某个数据值。

英文原文: A debug planet modifier that visualizes the biome data on the planet surface.
当前中文: 一种调试用行星修改器，用于在行星表面可视化生物群系数据。

英文原文: The amplitude of the domain warping noise.
The domain warping type. Domain warping adjusts the input position before generating the actual noise, thus 'warping' it. Some types use additional noise to perform the warping.
当前中文: 域扭曲类型。域扭曲会在生成实际噪声之前调整输入位置，从而「扭曲」它。部分类型会使用额外的噪声来完成扭曲。

英文原文: The frequency of the domain warping noise.
The gain of the domain warping noise.
The interpolation method of the domain warping noise. Linear is the fastest and lowest quality. Quintic is the slowest and best quality.
当前中文: 域扭曲噪声的插值方式。线性最快、质量最低；五次最慢、质量最好。

英文原文: The lacunarity of the domain warping noise.
The number of octaves for the domain warping noise.
The X,Y,Z offset to apply to the input position before generating the noise value for that position.
当前中文: 在为某位置生成噪声值之前，施加到该输入位置的 X、Y、Z 偏移。

英文原文: The euler angles, in degrees, to rotate the input position before generating the noise value for that position.
当前中文: 在为某位置生成噪声值之前，用于旋转该输入位置的欧拉角（度）。

英文原文: The noise seed value used for the domain warping noise.
当前中文: 域扭曲噪声所使用的噪声种子值。

英文原文: The amount of twist (in degrees) to apply to the lines in a single hemisphere.
当前中文: 单个半球上对线条施加的扭转量（度）。

英文原文: The axis around which to apply the twisting.
The exponent to apply to the twist amount. Increasing this can reduce the twisting near the equator and increase the twisting near the poles.
当前中文: 施加到扭转量上的指数。增大此值可减弱赤道附近的扭转、增强两极附近的扭转。

英文原文: How the twist strength at a given position is determined. Distance On Axis - twisting increases as distance along the axis increases. Distance On Axis Inverse - twisting decreases as distance along the axis increases. Distance From Axis - twisting increases as distance from the axis increases. Distance From Axis Inverse - twisting decreases as distance from the axis increases.
当前中文: 某位置扭转强度的确定方式。沿轴距离——扭转随沿轴距离增大而增强。沿轴距离反向——扭转随沿轴距离增大而减弱。距轴距离——扭转随距轴距离增大而增强。距轴距离反向——扭转随距轴距离增大而减弱。

英文原文: The X,Y,Z scale to apply to the input position before generating the noise value for that position.
当前中文: 在为某位置生成噪声值之前，施加到该输入位置的 X、Y、Z 缩放。

英文原文: The data output of the expression.
A planet modifier that evaluates a mathematical expression using data values as inputs.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，使用数据值作为输入来求值数学表达式。

英文原文: The data input values to act as a mask. At 1.0, the terrain is completely flattened, fading out to the original height at 0.0.
当前中文: 作为遮罩的数据输入值。为 1.0 时地形被完全平整，到 0.0 时渐变为原始高度。

英文原文: A planet modifier that flattens the terrain in an area.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于平整某一区域内的地形。

英文原文: The height, in meters, to which the terrain should be flattened.
当前中文: 地形应被平整到的高度（米）。

英文原文: If enabled, the input value will have a smoothstep function applied to it before use as a flatten mask.
当前中文: 若启用，输入值在用作平整遮罩前会先应用平滑阶跃函数。

英文原文: The input data value that is used to generate the heights.
当前中文: 用于生成高度的输入数据值。

英文原文: The data output that stores the generated height data.
当前中文: 存储所生成高度数据的数据输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that generates height data for the planet terrain.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于为行星地形生成高度数据。

英文原文: How the data input is interpreted to generate a height output. Lerp Min To Max: height is linearly interpolated from minimum to maximum based on the input value and its specified range. Lerp To/From Zero: height is linearly interpolated from minimum to zero if the input is negative, or from zero to maximum if positive. Don't use this if the minimum and maximum heights don't span across zero.
当前中文: 如何解释数据输入以生成高度输出。最小值插值至最大值：高度根据输入值及其指定范围，从最小值到最大值线性插值。与零值双向插值：若输入为负，高度从最小值线性插值到零；若为正，则从零线性插值到最大值。若最小与最大高度不跨越零，请勿使用此项。

英文原文: The maximum input value used to create the range by which the input value will be linearly interpolated.
当前中文: 用于构成范围的最大输入值，输入值将在此范围内线性插值。

英文原文: The minimum input value used to create the range by which the input value will be linearly interpolated.
当前中文: 用于构成范围的最小输入值，输入值将在此范围内线性插值。

英文原文: The maximum height (in meters) generated by this modifier.
当前中文: 此修改器生成的最大高度（米）。

英文原文: The minimum height (in meters) generated by this modifier.
当前中文: 此修改器生成的最小高度（米）。

英文原文: The output in which to store the biome strength (a value between 0 and 1).
当前中文: 用于存储生物群系强度（0 到 1 之间的值）的输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads the strength of a specific biome into a data value.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将指定生物群系的强度读入数据值。

英文原文: The output in which to store the combined biome strength (typically a value between 0 and 1).
当前中文: 用于存储合计生物群系强度（通常为 0 到 1 之间的值）的输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads the combined strength of all biomes into a data value.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将所有生物群系的合计强度读入数据值。
获取生物群系强度（合计）
获取生物群系强度（合计）

英文原文: The data from the common pass that is to be stored in the biome specific pass data channel.
当前中文: 要存入生物群系专属通道数据的、来自公共通道的数据。

英文原文: The biome specific pass data output.
当前中文: 生物群系专属通道的数据输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads data from the common pass into the current pass data.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将公共通道的数据读入当前通道数据。

英文原文: The data output to store the constant value.
当前中文: 用于存储常量值的数据输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that writes a constant value into a data slot.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将常量值写入数据槽。

英文原文: The constant value to store in the data output.
当前中文: 要存入数据输出的常量值。

英文原文: The output data to contain the strength of the current biome (typically a value between 0 and 1).
当前中文: 用于存放当前生物群系强度的输出数据（通常为 0 到 1 之间的值）。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads the strength of the current biome into a data value.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将当前生物群系的强度读入数据值。
获取生物群系强度（当前）
获取生物群系强度（当前）

英文原文: The data output used to store the requested height value (in meters).
当前中文: 用于存储所获取高度值（米）的数据输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads the current terrain height into a data slot.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将当前地形高度读入数据槽。

英文原文: The type of height value to retrieve. Default: the common height in a non-biome pass, the biome height in a biome pass. Common Height: the common height, regardless of pass. Biome Height: the biome height in a biome pass; retrieves the common height if run in a non-biome pass. Combined Height: biome height plus common height in a biome pass; retrieves the common height if run in a non-biome pass.
当前中文: 要获取的高度值类型。默认：非生物群系通道中取公共高度，生物群系通道中取生物群系高度。公共高度：无论哪个通道都取公共高度。生物群系高度：在生物群系通道中取生物群系高度；在非生物群系通道中运行时取公共高度。合计高度：在生物群系通道中取生物群系高度加公共高度；在非生物群系通道中运行时取公共高度。

英文原文: If enabled, the radius of the celestial body will be added to the output of the modifier. This is typically not enabled.
当前中文: 若启用，天体的半径将加到修改器的输出上。通常不启用。

英文原文: The data output used to store the X-position value.
当前中文: 用于存储 X 坐标值的数据输出。

英文原文: The data output used to store the Y-position value.
当前中文: 用于存储 Y 坐标值的数据输出。

英文原文: The data output used to store the Z-position value.
当前中文: 用于存储 Z 坐标值的数据输出。

英文原文: A planet modifier that reads the current vertex position into data slots.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将当前顶点位置读入数据槽。

英文原文: The rotation in degrees about the X, Y, and Z axis to be applied to the planet before returning the requested positions.
当前中文: 在返回所需位置之前，绕 X、Y、Z 轴施加到行星上的旋转角度（度）。

英文原文: A planet modifier that swaps biomes between hemispheres.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于在两个半球之间交换生物群系。

英文原文: The 'A' input to be interpolated. The result will be interpolated from input 'A' to input 'B'.
当前中文: 要插值的「A」输入。结果将从输入「A」插值到输入「B」。

英文原文: The 'B' input to be interpolated. The result will be interpolated from input 'A' to input 'B'.
当前中文: 要插值的「B」输入。结果将从输入「A」插值到输入「B」。

英文原文: The value used to interpolate between the two inputs. Below the min input value, the output is input 'A'. Above the max input value, the output is input 'B'. In between, the output is interpolated based on where this value falls in the specified min/max range.
当前中文: 用于在两个输入之间插值的值。低于最小输入值时，输出为输入「A」；高于最大输入值时，输出为输入「B」；介于两者之间时，输出按该值在指定最小/最大范围内的位置插值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that interpolates between two values based on a factor.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于依系数在两个值之间插值。

英文原文: The maximum input value used to create the range for the interpolation value input.
当前中文: 用于构建插值系数输入范围的最大输入值。

英文原文: The minimum input value used to create the range for the interpolation value input.
当前中文: 用于构建插值系数输入范围的最小输入值。

英文原文: The exponent to which the interpolation value is raised after remapping it into the 0 to 1 range based on the min/max input values. A value of 1 gives linear interpolation. A value above or below one makes interpolation occur over a curve.
当前中文: 在按最小/最大输入值将插值系数重映射到 0 到 1 区间后，对其施加的指数。值为 1 时为线性插值；大于或小于 1 时插值沿曲线进行。

英文原文: A planet modifier that defines biomes arranged in horizontal layers.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于定义按水平层排布的生物群系。
双生物群系（正向与余量）

英文原文: Determines how the input is converted to biomes. Single Biome - The input value is the primary biome's strength, from 0% at 0 to 100% at 1. Dual Biome Negative And Positive - The input value represents two biomes. The primary biome's strength runs from 0 (0%) to 1 (100%); the other biome's from 0 (0%) to -1 (100%). Dual Biome Positive And Remainder - The input value represents two biomes. The primary biome's strength runs from 0 (0%) to 1 (100%); the other biome's strength is 100% minus the primary's.
当前中文: 决定输入如何转换为生物群系。单生物群系——输入值即主生物群系的强度，0 处为 0%、1 处为 100%。双生物群系（正负）——输入值代表两个生物群系：主生物群系强度从 0（0%）到 1（100%），另一生物群系从 0（0%）到 -1（100%）。双生物群系（正向与余量）——输入值代表两个生物群系：主生物群系强度从 0（0%）到 1（100%），另一生物群系的强度为 100% 减去主生物群系的强度。

英文原文: The 'A' input to be interpolated. The result will be interpolated from input 'A' to input 'B'.
当前中文: 要插值的「A」输入。结果将从输入「A」插值到输入「B」。

英文原文: The 'B' input to be interpolated. The result will be interpolated from input 'A' to input 'B'.
当前中文: 要插值的「B」输入。结果将从输入「A」插值到输入「B」。

英文原文: The value used to interpolate between the two inputs. If this value is below the min input value, the output will be input 'A'. If this value is above the max input value, the output will be input 'B'. If this value is in between those two values, the output will be linearly interpolated based on where this value falls between zero and one.
当前中文: 用于在两个输入之间插值的值。若该值低于最小输入值，输出为输入「A」；若高于最大输入值，输出为输入「B」；若介于两者之间，输出将按该值在 0 到 1 之间的位置线性插值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that linearly interpolates a value from range A to range B, mapping it to the 0-1 range.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将值从范围 A 线性插值到范围 B，并映射到 0-1 区间。

英文原文: The optional noise input applied to the lines. The input value is used as longitude variation in degrees, so a value of 1 shifts a line's output position by one degree. Typically this input comes from a noise modifier with a strength value of 'x' degrees.
当前中文: 施加到线条上的可选噪声输入。输入值被用作以度为单位的经度变化量，因此值 1 会把线条的输出位置移动一度。通常该输入来自强度值为「x」度的噪声修改器。

英文原文: The output data representing the lines calculated by this modifier. This should be in the range of zero (no lines) to 1 (center of line).
当前中文: 表示此修改器所计算线条的输出数据。应处于零（无线条）到 1（线条中心）的范围内。

英文原文: A planet modifier that generates longitude lines on the planet surface.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于在行星表面生成经线。

英文原文: The number of lines to be generated by this modifier.
当前中文: 此修改器要生成的线条数量。

英文原文: The width of the lines, in degrees, generated by this modifier.
当前中文: 此修改器生成的线条宽度（度）。

英文原文: The rotation in degrees about the X, Y, and Z axis to be applied to the input position.
当前中文: 绕 X、Y、Z 轴施加到输入位置的旋转角度（度）。

英文原文: The amplitude of the domain warping noise applied to the input.
当前中文: 施加到输入上的域扭曲噪声的振幅。

英文原文: The frequency of the domain warping noise applied to the input.
当前中文: 施加到输入上的域扭曲噪声的频率。

英文原文: The gain applied to the amplitude at each octave of the domain warping noise applied to the input.
当前中文: 施加到输入上的域扭曲噪声在每一倍频上作用于振幅的增益。

英文原文: The lacunarity applied to the frequency at each octave of the domain warping noise applied to the input.
当前中文: 施加到输入上的域扭曲噪声在每一倍频上作用于频率的间隙度。

英文原文: The number of octaves used in the domain warping noise applied to the input.
当前中文: 施加到输入上的域扭曲噪声所使用的倍频数。

英文原文: The output data value representing the polar caps. The north pole mask runs from zero to 1, the south pole mask from 0 to -1.
当前中文: 表示极冠的输出数据值。北极遮罩从零到 1，南极遮罩从 0 到 -1。

英文原文: A planet modifier that generates a mask for the polar cap regions of the planet.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于生成行星极冠区域的遮罩。

英文原文: A planet modifier that flattens terrain radially around a point.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于围绕某点径向平整地形。

英文原文: The falloff power used when interpolating between the target elevation and original elevation.
当前中文: 在目标海拔与原始海拔之间插值时所用的衰减幂。

英文原文: The inner radius, in meters, of the terrain to flatten. All terrain within this radius is set to the specified elevation. The elevation is interpolated back to non-flattened terrain from the inner radius to the outer radius.
当前中文: 要平整的地形内半径（米）。此半径内的所有地形都设为指定海拔。从内半径到外半径，海拔插值回未平整的地形。

英文原文: The latitude and longitude of the center point of the radial flatten.
当前中文: 径向平整中心点的纬度和经度。

英文原文: The outer radius, in meters, of the terrain to flatten. All terrain beyond it is unaffected by this modifier. Elevation is interpolated from flattened to non-flattened terrain between the inner and outer radius.
当前中文: 要平整的地形外半径（米）。超出此范围的地形不受此修改器影响。在内半径与外半径之间，海拔从平整地形插值到未平整地形。

英文原文: Use the Smooth Step function instead of a falloff power curve. If selected, then Falloff Power will be ignored.
当前中文: 使用平滑阶跃函数而非衰减幂曲线。若选中此项，衰减幂将被忽略。

英文原文: The data input values to be remapped.
当前中文: 要重映射的数据输入值。

英文原文: The output results of the modifier.
A planet modifier that remaps a data value using an animation curve.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于通过动画曲线重映射数据值。

英文原文: The curve used to remap the input values. The X-axis represents the input values and the Y-axis defines the values they will be remapped to.
当前中文: 用于重映射输入值的曲线。X 轴表示输入值，Y 轴定义它们将被重映射到的值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that linearly remaps a data value from one range to another.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将数据值从一个范围线性重映射到另一个范围。

英文原文: The maximum value of the range from which values are remapped. Input values at or beyond this are remapped to 'To Max Value'. Input values between 'From Min Value' and this are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and 'To Max Value'.
当前中文: 要重映射的源范围的最大值。等于或超过此值的输入将重映射为「目标最大值」。介于「源最小值」与此值之间的输入，在「目标最小值」与「目标最大值」之间线性插值。

英文原文: The minimum value of the range that values are remapped from. Input values at or below this remap to 'To Min Value'. Input values between this and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and 'To Max Value'.
当前中文: 要重映射的源范围的最小值。等于或低于此值的输入将重映射为「目标最小值」。介于此值与「源最大值」之间的输入，在「目标最小值」与「目标最大值」之间线性插值。

英文原文: The maximum value of the range to which values are remapped. Input values at or beyond 'From Max Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and this.
当前中文: 要重映射到的目标范围的最大值。等于或超过「源最大值」的输入将重映射为此值。介于「源最小值」与「源最大值」之间的输入，在「目标最小值」与此值之间线性插值。

英文原文: The minimum value of the range that values are remapped to. Input values at or below 'From Min Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between this and 'To Max Value'.
当前中文: 要重映射到的目标范围的最小值。等于或低于「源最小值」的输入将重映射为此值。介于「源最小值」与「源最大值」之间的输入，在此值与「目标最大值」之间线性插值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that linearly remaps a data value using a mirrored dual range.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于按镜像双范围线性重映射数据值。

英文原文: The maximum value of the range from which values are remapped. Input values at or beyond this are remapped to 'To Max Value'. Input values between 'From Min Value' and this are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and 'To Max Value'. These results are mirrored about zero when the input is below zero.
当前中文: 要重映射的源范围的最大值。等于或超过此值的输入将重映射为「目标最大值」。介于「源最小值」与此值之间的输入，在「目标最小值」与「目标最大值」之间线性插值。当输入为负时，这些结果以零为轴镜像。

英文原文: The minimum value of the range being remapped from. Input values at or below this are remapped to 'To Min Value'. Inputs between this and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and 'To Max Value'. Results are mirrored about zero when the input is below zero.
当前中文: 要重映射的源范围的最小值。等于或低于此值的输入将重映射为「目标最小值」。介于此值与「源最大值」之间的输入，在「目标最小值」与「目标最大值」之间线性插值。当输入为负时，结果以零为轴镜像。

英文原文: The maximum value of the range that values are remapped to. Input values at or beyond 'From Max Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between 'To Min Value' and this. These results are mirrored about zero when the input is below zero.
当前中文: 要重映射到的目标范围的最大值。等于或超过「源最大值」的输入将重映射为此值。介于「源最小值」与「源最大值」之间的输入，在「目标最小值」与此值之间线性插值。当输入为负时，这些结果以零为轴镜像。

英文原文: The minimum value of the range that values are remapped to. Input values at or below 'From Min Value' remap to this. Input values between 'From Min Value' and 'From Max Value' are linearly interpolated between this and 'To Max Value'. Results are mirrored about zero when the input is below zero.
当前中文: 要重映射到的目标范围的最小值。等于或低于「源最小值」的输入将重映射为此值。介于「源最小值」与「源最大值」之间的输入，在此值与「目标最大值」之间线性插值。当输入为负时，结果以零为轴镜像。

英文原文: Marks which data slot holds the ISRU resource patchiness field (0..1). Author the value upstream with the normal noise/remap/combine modifiers; each sub-biome's Noise Strength slider then chooses how much of it to apply.
当前中文: 标记哪个数据槽存放 ISRU 资源疏密场（0..1）。请在上游用常规的噪声/重映射/组合修改器生成该值；之后每个子生物群系的噪声强度滑块决定应用其中多少。

英文原文: The data slot whose value (clamped to 0..1) is used as the ISRU resource patchiness field. Author it upstream with the noise/remap/combine modifiers. Leave unset (-1) for uniform resource coverage.
当前中文: 其值（截断到 0..1）被用作 ISRU 资源疏密场的数据槽。请在上游用噪声/重映射/组合修改器生成。若留空（-1），则资源均匀覆盖。

英文原文: The data input value that, along with the biome range values, determines the biome(s) to which the source biome's strength should be re-assigned.
当前中文: 结合生物群系范围值，决定源生物群系的强度应重新分配给哪个（些）生物群系的数据输入值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that redistributes biome boundaries based on data values.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于根据数据值重新分配生物群系边界。

英文原文: The data input value that, along with the biome range values, determines the biome(s) that should be assigned.
当前中文: 结合生物群系范围值，决定应分配哪个（些）生物群系的数据输入值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that defines biomes based on a data value range.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于根据数据值范围定义生物群系。

英文原文: A planet modifier that defines a single sub-biome for a biome.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于为某个生物群系定义单个子生物群系。

英文原文: The data input containing the values that define the sub-biomes.
当前中文: 包含定义子生物群系的值的数据输入。

英文原文: A planet modifier that defines sub-biomes for a biome based on a data value range.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于根据数据值范围为某个生物群系定义子生物群系。

英文原文: The list of sub-biomes and their associated data defined for this biome.
当前中文: 为此生物群系定义的子生物群系列表及其关联数据。

英文原文: If enabled, input values beyond the final terrace section's 'Start Value' are clamped to that 'Start Value'. If disabled, input values exceeding the final 'Start Value' pass through untouched to the output.
当前中文: 若启用，超出最后一个阶地段「起始值」的输入值将被限制到该「起始值」。若禁用，超出最后一个「起始值」的输入值将原样传递到输出。

英文原文: If enabled, input values below the first terrace section's 'Start Value' are clamped to that 'Start Value'. If disabled, input values below the first 'Start Value' pass untouched to the output.
当前中文: 若启用，低于第一个阶地段「起始值」的输入值将被限制到该「起始值」。若禁用，低于第一个「起始值」的输入值将原样传递到输出。

英文原文: The data input value to convert to a terraced output value. This value can be in any range, as long as the corresponding start values for each section use the same range.
当前中文: 要转换为阶地输出值的数据输入值。该值可处于任意范围，只要各分段对应的起始值使用相同范围即可。

英文原文: The data output of the modifier.
A planet modifier that generates terraced terrain features.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于生成阶地地形特征。

英文原文: The percentage of this terrace section that will be completely flat. The section extends from its start value to the next section's start value. This defines the percentage of that range where output is always set to this section's start value. The rest is the slope to the next terrace section.
当前中文: 此阶地段中完全平坦所占的百分比。该段从其起始值延伸到下一段的起始值。此项定义该范围内输出始终设为本段起始值的比例；其余部分则是通往下一阶地段的坡度。

英文原文: The exponent defining how this terrace section's slope is interpolated from its start value to the next section's start value. A value of 1 results in linear interpolation of the slope from this section to the next.
当前中文: 定义此阶地段的坡度如何从其起始值插值到下一段起始值的指数。值为 1 时，坡度从此段到下一段为线性插值。

英文原文: The data input value at which this terrace section starts.
当前中文: 此阶地段开始处的数据输入值。

英文原文: A planet modifier used to read data from a specific face of a cubemap texture and project it onto the planet surface.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于从立方体贴图的指定面读取数据并投影到行星表面。

英文原文: A planet modifier used to read data from a texture and project it onto the planet surface using latitude/longitude coordinates.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于从贴图读取数据并按经纬度坐标投影到行星表面。

英文原文: The cube face of the texture's center position.
当前中文: 贴图中心位置所在的立方体面。

英文原文: The interpolation method used when sampling the texture data. Bilinear should be much faster. Bicubic should be smoother, but won't always look better than bilinear, since the look depends heavily on the texture content and resolution as well as the texture's size on the celestial body. Stick with bilinear for performance unless bicubic offers a far better visual result.
当前中文: 采样贴图数据时所用的插值方式。双线性要快得多。双三次更平滑，但未必总比双线性好看，因为视觉效果很大程度上取决于贴图内容与分辨率，以及贴图在天体上的大小。除非双三次的视觉效果明显更好，否则建议用双线性以保性能。

英文原文: The maximum value this texture generates, added to the modifier output for a max-value pixel. For example, if this is 100 and pixels range from 0 to 255, then a pixel of 0 generates 0, a pixel of 102 generates 40, and a pixel of 255 generates 100.
当前中文: 此贴图生成的最大值，会加到最大像素值对应的修改器输出上。例如取 100 且像素范围为 0 到 255 时，像素 0 生成 0，像素 102 生成 40，像素 255 生成 100。

英文原文: The position of the center of the texture on the cube face. Coordinates are unit cube space, from -0.5 to 0.5.
当前中文: 贴图中心在立方体面上的位置。坐标为归一化立方体空间，从 -0.5 到 0.5。

英文原文: The rotation of the texture in degrees. NOTE: Only increments of 90 degrees will work.
当前中文: 贴图的旋转角度（度）。注意：仅 90 度的整数倍有效。

英文原文: The size of the texture relative to the cube face. Coordinates are unit cube space with a size value of 1 filling the entire cubemap face.
当前中文: 贴图相对于立方体面的大小。坐标为归一化立方体空间，值为 1 时填满整个立方体贴图面。

英文原文: The interpolation method used when sampling the texture data. Bilinear should be much faster. Bicubic should be smoother, but won't always look better than bilinear, since the look depends heavily on the texture content and resolution as well as the projected texture size. Stick with bilinear for performance unless bicubic offers a far better visual result.
当前中文: 采样贴图数据时所用的插值方式。双线性要快得多。双三次更平滑，但未必总比双线性好看，因为视觉效果很大程度上取决于贴图内容与分辨率，以及投影贴图的大小。除非双三次的视觉效果明显更好，否则建议用双线性以保性能。

英文原文: The latitude at which this texture data should be centered and projected onto the celestial body.
当前中文: 此贴图数据应以之居中并投影到天体上的纬度。

英文原文: The longitude at which this texture data should be centered and projected onto the celestial body.
当前中文: 此贴图数据应以之居中并投影到天体上的经度。

英文原文: The texture data to be projected onto the celestial body.
当前中文: 要投影到天体上的贴图数据。

英文原文: The rotation of the projected texture in degrees.
当前中文: 所投影贴图的旋转角度（度）。

英文原文: The size of the texture projected onto the planet, relative to a unit sphere. This size is not related to or affected by the radius of the celestial body.
当前中文: 投影到行星上的贴图大小，相对于单位球。此大小与天体半径无关，也不受其影响。

英文原文: The ID of the custom data to be updated.
当前中文: 要更新的自定义数据的 ID。

英文原文: The data input used to update the custom data value.
当前中文: 用于更新自定义数据值的数据输入。

英文原文: The data input used to update the W component of the custom data value.
当前中文: 用于更新自定义数据值 W 分量的数据输入。

英文原文: The data input used to update the X component of the custom data value.
当前中文: 用于更新自定义数据值 X 分量的数据输入。

英文原文: The data input used to update the Y component of the custom data value.
当前中文: 用于更新自定义数据值 Y 分量的数据输入。

英文原文: The data input used to update the Z component of the custom data value.
当前中文: 用于更新自定义数据值 Z 分量的数据输入。

英文原文: A planet modifier that updates a custom data value of type double.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于更新 double 类型的自定义数据值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that updates a custom data value of type float.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于更新 float 类型的自定义数据值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that updates a custom data value of type Vector2d.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于更新 Vector2d 类型的自定义数据值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that updates a custom data value of type Vector3d.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于更新 Vector3d 类型的自定义数据值。

英文原文: A planet modifier that updates a custom data value of type Vector4d.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于更新 Vector4d 类型的自定义数据值。

英文原文: The data input used to update the height of the terrain. This should be the height, in meters, to be added to the current terrain height.
当前中文: 用于更新地形高度的数据输入。应为要加到当前地形高度上的高度（米）。

英文原文: A planet modifier that applies a data value as an update to the final terrain height.
当前中文: 一种行星修改器，用于将数据值作为对最终地形高度的更新施加。

英文原文: If enabled and running for a specific biome, the biome's strength is ignored when applying the height. If disabled, the height is scaled by the strength of the biome this modifier is running for.
当前中文: 若启用且为特定生物群系运行，施加高度时会忽略该生物群系的强度。若禁用，高度将按此修改器所运行的生物群系强度缩放。

英文原文: May need more battery to operate.
当前中文: 运行可能需要更多电量。

英文原文: The value range for this sub-biome, defined as min and max values from the input data that defines it. The min/max values should overlap neighboring sub-biomes for a smooth transition between them.
当前中文: 此子生物群系的取值范围，由定义它的输入数据的最小值和最大值决定。相邻子生物群系的最小/最大值应相互重叠，以便彼此平滑过渡。

英文原文: The method used to calculate distance when using cellular noise.
当前中文: 使用蜂窝噪声时计算距离所采用的方式。

英文原文: When using cellular noise, this determines what kind of values will be stored as the output of this modifier.
当前中文: 使用蜂窝噪声时，此项决定以何种值作为此修改器的输出。

英文原文: The output of this noise modifier. Many noise methods are capped between -1 and 1, but that is not always the case.
当前中文: 此噪声修改器的输出。许多噪声方式的输出被限制在 -1 与 1 之间，但并非总是如此。

英文原文: A highly configurable planet modifier that can be used to generate all sorts of noise.
当前中文: 一种高度可配置的行星修改器，可用于生成各类噪声。

英文原文: Typically each octave scales the previous octave's amplitude by the 'Gain' value. If set to manual, the amplitude at each octave can be set to a specific value. This is an advanced technique, generally not recommended, but it can be very useful in some scenarios.
当前中文: 通常每个倍频会把上一倍频的振幅乘以「增益」值。若设为手动，可指定每个倍频的振幅。这是进阶技巧，一般不建议使用，但在某些场景下非常有用。

英文原文: Typically each octave of noise scales the previous octave's frequency by the 'Lacunarity' value. If set to manual, the frequency at each octave can be set to a specific value. This is an advanced technique, generally not recommended, but it can be very useful in some scenarios.
当前中文: 通常每个噪声倍频会把上一倍频的频率乘以「间隙度」值。若设为手动，可指定每个倍频的频率。这是进阶技巧，一般不建议使用，但在某些场景下非常有用。

英文原文: For fractal-based noise, this sets the fractal type. They each behave in different, interesting ways. It's best to just experiment with each to get a feel for what they do and how the various settings affect them. Good luck!
当前中文: 对于基于分形的噪声，此项设定分形类型。它们各自的表现都不同而有趣。最好逐一试验，感受它们的效果以及各项设置对它们的影响。祝你好运！

英文原文: If using fractal-with-derivative-based noise, this sets the type used. These all behave in different and interesting ways. It's best to experiment with each to get a feel for what they do and how the various settings affect them. Good luck!
当前中文: 若使用基于导数的分形噪声，此项设定所用的类型。它们各自的表现都不同而有趣。最好逐一试验，感受它们的效果以及各项设置对它们的影响。祝你好运！

英文原文: The number of cycles per unit length.
A multiplier that determines how the strength changes with each successive octave.
当前中文: 一个乘数，决定强度如何随每个后续倍频变化。

英文原文: The interpolation method used by the noise. Linear is the fastest and lowest quality. Quintic is the slowest and best quality.
当前中文: 噪声所用的插值方式。线性最快、质量最低；五次最慢、质量最好。

英文原文: A multiplier that determines how quickly the frequency increases for each successive octave.
当前中文: 决定每层倍频频率递增速度的乘数。

英文原文: This is the color gradient that will be used on the brush painting flyout if a custom map is painted for this modifier.
当前中文: 为此修改器绘制自定义贴图时，笔刷面板中使用的颜色渐变。

英文原文: If enabled, this will ignore any custom map that has been created (using the brush flyout) for this modifier.
当前中文: 启用后，将忽略为此修改器创建的任何自定义贴图（通过笔刷面板创建）。

英文原文: The maximum value represented by map pixel data.
当前中文: 贴图像素数据所表示的最大值。

英文原文: The minimum value represented by map pixel data.
当前中文: 贴图像素数据所表示的最小值。

英文原文: The ID of the optional map for this modifier. If left blank, this brush flyout can't use this modifier to create custom painted maps. This should be a unique name within the celestial body being created.
当前中文: 此修改器可选贴图的 ID。留空则笔刷面板无法使用此修改器创建自定义绘制贴图。此名称在所创建的天体内应当唯一。

英文原文: If enabled and a cubemap is used, the regular noise will be combined with the cubemap noise. If false, only the cubemap noise value is returned.
当前中文: 启用并使用立方体贴图时，常规噪声会与立方体贴图噪声叠加。若关闭，则仅返回立方体贴图噪声值。

英文原文: The strength of the noise used with a custom map.
当前中文: 自定义贴图所用噪声的强度。

英文原文: If a custom cubemap is used, this sets the sampling mode for applying the map data to the planet. Bicubic generally looks better (not always), but it's much more expensive than Bilinear.
当前中文: 使用自定义立方体贴图时，此项设定将贴图数据应用到行星的采样模式。双三次通常（但不总是）效果更好，但比双线性开销大得多。

英文原文: The optional data input used as a mask for this modifier. These values are typically 0 to 1 and scale the strength of the noise result.
当前中文: 用作此修改器遮罩的可选数据输入。这些值通常为 0 到 1，会按比例缩放噪声结果的强度。

英文原文: The number of times to run the noise, each time modifying its frequency by lacunarity and its strength by gain. More octaves can improve visuals but reduce runtime performance.
当前中文: 噪声的迭代次数，每次迭代按间隙度调整频率、按增益调整强度。倍频越多画面越佳，但会降低运行性能。

英文原文: The power exponent used in some noise types.
当前中文: 某些噪声类型使用的幂指数。

英文原文: The seed value for the noise. Each unique seed should produce completely unique noise for a given set of configuration values.
当前中文: 噪声的种子值。对于同一组配置值，每个唯一种子都应生成完全不同的噪声。

英文原文: The strength of the 'slope erosion' used by some noise types.
当前中文: 某些噪声类型使用的「坡面侵蚀」强度。

英文原文: Clicking on a mod below will search the Juno: New Origins website for that mod.
当前中文: 点击下方模组将在 Juno: New Origins 网站上搜索该模组。

英文原文: One or more of these mods require code execution support which is not supported by this version of the game.
当前中文: 其中一个或多个模组需要代码执行支持，而此版本游戏不支持该功能。

英文原文: One or more of these mods require code execution support which is not supported by this device.
当前中文: 其中一个或多个模组需要代码执行支持，而此设备不支持该功能。

英文原文: Loading this item requires the following mods.
当前中文: 加载此项目需要以下模组。

英文原文: Loading this item requires the following mods, some of which require code execution support which is not supported by this version of the game.
当前中文: 加载此项目需要以下模组，其中一些需要代码执行支持，而此版本游戏不支持该功能。

英文原文: Loading this item requires the following mods, some of which require code execution support which is not supported by this device.
当前中文: 加载此项目需要以下模组，其中一些需要代码执行支持，而此设备不支持该功能。

英文原文: Loading this item requires the following mods, some of which are not currently installed or enabled.
当前中文: 加载此项目需要以下模组，其中一些当前未安装或未启用。

英文原文: Loading this item requires the following mods, some of which are installed but they are out of date and need updating.
当前中文: 加载此项目需要以下模组，其中一些已安装但已过期，需要更新。

英文原文: The selected element cannot be duplicated.
Cannot move the selection because it contains at least one element that is not compatible with the destination:
当前中文: 无法移动所选内容，因为它包含至少一个与目标不兼容的元素：

英文原文: Please confirm that you want to delete the '{0}' container and all of its children.
当前中文: 请确认要删除「{0}」容器及其全部子项。

英文原文: Please confirm that you want to delete the '{0}' element.

This modifier is disabled when ANY of these symbols are defined. Use a comma-separated list of 'symbols'.

CUBEMAP: Defined when the cubemap is generated for the planet (used in map view and distant viewing).

EQUIRECTANGULARMAP: Defined when the equirectangular map is generated for the planet.

Cubemap - [MapName]: Defined when a planet brush cubemap (created with the brush flyout) exists for the planet, with [MapName] replaced by the actual name of the planet brush cubemap.
当前中文:
当定义了以下任意符号时，此修改器将被禁用。请使用逗号分隔的「符号」列表。

CUBEMAP：为行星生成立方体贴图时定义（用于地图视图和远景查看）。

EQUIRECTANGULARMAP：为行星生成等距圆柱贴图时定义。

Cubemap - [MapName]：行星存在行星笔刷立方体贴图（通过笔刷面板创建）时定义，其中 [MapName] 替换为该行星笔刷立方体贴图的实际名称。

英文原文:
This modifier is enabled only when ALL of these symbols are defined. Use a comma-separated list of 'symbols'.

CUBEMAP: Defined when the planet's cubemap is generated (used in map view and distant viewing).

EQUIRECTANGULARMAP: Defined when the planet's equirectangular map is generated.

Cubemap - [MapName]: Defined when a planet brush cubemap (created with the brush flyout) exists for the planet, with [MapName] replaced by the brush cubemap's actual name.
当前中文:
仅当定义了以下全部符号时，此修改器才会启用。请使用逗号分隔的「符号」列表。

CUBEMAP：生成行星的立方体贴图时定义（用于地图视图和远景查看）。

EQUIRECTANGULARMAP：生成行星的等距圆柱贴图时定义。

Cubemap - [MapName]：行星存在行星笔刷立方体贴图（通过笔刷面板创建）时定义，其中 [MapName] 替换为笔刷立方体贴图的实际名称。

英文原文: Please select an element above before clicking the add button.
当前中文: 请先在上方选择一个元素，再点击添加按钮。

英文原文: Please select an element above before clicking the delete button.
当前中文: 请先在上方选择一个元素，再点击删除按钮。

英文原文: Select an element before clicking the duplicate button.
当前中文: 请先选择一个元素，再点击复制按钮。

英文原文: Toggles whether this modifier shows up in the 'Basic' view of the terrain generation flyout.

英文原文:
Auto-pilot uses a "PID" controller with 3 components: Proportional, Integral, and Derivative. Adjust them in-flight to find optimal values (View Panel->Auto-Pilot), then set them here to save with the craft.
The hard part of PID tuning is controlling oscillation when the craft is nearly on-target. Values should be large enough to produce the desired response rate without introducing oscillation, across a range of airspeeds. Any value, if too high, can cause oscillation.

To start tuning in flight: set integral and derivative to zero. Raise proportional until you reach the desired response rate with minimal oscillation (you may not eliminate it). Raise derivative until overshoot/oscillation is minimized. Add integral to fix any persistent error while keeping oscillation low. Tip: Display input sliders to monitor oscillation in inputs.
当前中文:
自动驾驶使用「PID」控制器，包含三个分量：比例、积分与微分。可在飞行中调整以找到最优值（查看面板 -> 自动驾驶），然后在此处设定，以便随载具一同保存。
PID 调参的难点在于载具接近目标时如何抑制振荡。取值应足够大，以在各类空速下产生所需的响应速度，同时不引入振荡。任何取值若过大都可能引起振荡。

开始飞行调参时：先将积分和微分设为零。逐步提高比例，直到获得所需的响应速度且振荡最小（可能无法完全消除）。再提高微分，直到超调/振荡降到最低。最后加入积分以消除持续误差，同时保持低振荡。提示：显示输入滑块，以便监视输入中的振荡。

英文原文:
A set of one, two, or three comma-separated numbers defining the input axis value range and how it remaps into the -1 to 1 range. 

{max} - Input axis values <= 0 are remapped to zero. Values >= {max} are remapped to 1. Values between 0 and {max} are lerped between 0 and 1. 

{min},{max} - Input axis values <= {min} are remapped to -1. Values >= {max} are remapped to 1. Values between {min} and {max} are lerped between -1 and 1. 

{min},{zero},{max} - Input axis values <= {min} are remapped to -1. Values >= {max} are remapped to 1. Values between {min} and {zero} are lerped between -1 and 0. Values between {zero} and {max} are lerped between 0 and 1. If {min} and {zero} are equal, inputs <= {min} are remapped to 0. If {zero} and {max} are equal, inputs >= {max} are remapped to 0.
当前中文:
一组由逗号分隔的一至三个数字，用于定义输入轴的值范围及其重新映射到 -1 至 1 区间的方式。 

{max} - 输入轴值 <= 0 时映射为零。值 >= {max} 时映射为 1。0 与 {max} 之间按 0 至 1 线性插值。 

{min},{max} - 输入轴值 <= {min} 时映射为 -1。值 >= {max} 时映射为 1。{min} 与 {max} 之间按 -1 至 1 线性插值。 

{min},{zero},{max} - 输入轴值 <= {min} 时映射为 -1。值 >= {max} 时映射为 1。{min} 与 {zero} 之间按 -1 至 0 线性插值。{zero} 与 {max} 之间按 0 至 1 线性插值。若 {min} 与 {zero} 相等，输入 <= {min} 时映射为 0。若 {zero} 与 {max} 相等，输入 >= {max} 时映射为 0。

当前中文: 决定轴值超出曲线范围时曲线的计算方式。

英文原文:
Standard - A positive axis will be multiplied by the max value. A negative axis will be multiplied by the min value. 

Lerp Full Axis - The output value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values assuming an input axis of -1 to 1. 

Lerp Positive Axis - The output value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values assuming an input axis of 0 to 1. 

Lerp Negative Axis - The output value will be linearly interpolated between the min and max values assuming an input axis of -1 to 0. 

Curve - The output will be evaluated on a user defined curve with the input axis acting as the time input.

负轴插值 - 假设输入轴为 -1 至 0，输出值将在最小值和最大值之间线性插值。 

曲线 - 输出将按用户定义的曲线计算，输入轴作为时间输入。

英文原文: The Biomes flyout panel customizes the look of specific regions of your planet. Each biome is split into one or more sub-biomes, which define the visual style for different altitudes within the same biome.\n\nFor example, imagine a grassland biome split into three sub-biomes that define how it changes visually as altitude increases. The first could start at -500 meters, well below sea level, and extend to 10 meters above it, with a sandy color and texture to represent beaches near sea level. The next could extend to 500 meters with a grassy color and texture. The last could run from 500 to 10,000 meters with a gray color and rocky texture to represent mountains.
当前中文: 生物群系面板用于自定义行星特定区域的外观。每个生物群系会被拆分为一个或多个子生物群系，它们定义同一生物群系内不同高度的视觉样式。\n\n例如，设想一个草原生物群系被拆分为三个子生物群系，分别定义它随高度升高时的外观变化。第一个可以从 -500 米开始（远低于海平面）一直延伸到海平面以上 10 米，用沙色与沙质贴图表现海平面附近的沙滩。第二个可以延伸到 500 米，用草色与草地贴图。最后一个可以从 500 米延伸到 10,000 米，用灰色与岩石贴图表现山脉。

英文原文: Looking closely at the diagram above, you'll notice each sub-biome overlaps by some amount. This overlap lets sub-biomes blend smoothly as they transition from one to another; the larger the overlap, the more gradual the transition.\n\nEach sub-biome can also define a different visual style based on slope. This is useful for something like a mountain where steep faces are gray but flat spots are white. View each sub-biome's settings via the Flat Style and Slope Style buttons. The Flat End Angle and Slope Start Angle define the range over which those styles blend together.
当前中文: 仔细观察上面的示意图，你会注意到每个子生物群系都有一定量的重叠。这种重叠让子生物群系在相互过渡时平滑混合；重叠越大，过渡越平缓。\n\n每个子生物群系还可以根据坡度定义不同的视觉样式。这对山脉这类地形很有用：陡峭的坡面是灰色，平坦处则是白色。可通过「平坦样式」和「坡面样式」按钮查看各子生物群系的设置。「平坦结束角」和「坡面起始角」定义这些样式相互混合的范围。

英文原文: Some planets define their sub-biomes by a value instead of a height, which requires the Sub-Biomes (Value Based) planet modifier for each biome. This can be more flexible and makes it easier to scale your planet's terrain features without changing sub-biome ranges, but it's harder to set up and less intuitive to work with.
当前中文: 有些行星用数值而不是高度来定义子生物群系，这需要为每个生物群系添加「子生物群系（基于数值）」行星修改器。这样更灵活，也更容易在不改变子生物群系范围的前提下缩放行星的地形特征，但设置更困难，用起来也更不直观。

The Celestial Body Designer is where you build custom celestial bodies (aka planets). Several flyout panels let you customize different parts of your planet.

The Properties flyout holds general info such as radius, gravity, atmosphere settings, and more. Settings are extensively tool-tipped, so read those for details on a particular setting.

Some settings apply immediately, but others require "rebuilding the planet," done via the Rebuild button in the Celestial Body inspector panel at the top right of the screen. When a rebuild is needed, the button turns blue, as shown below.

英文原文: There are two types of data slots: common and biome. During common passes, all planet modifiers write to and read from common data slots. In a biome pass, data is written to and read from a temporary set of slots that reset after each biome pass. A biome pass cannot write to common data slots, but it can read them with a GetCommonData modifier, which reads from a common data slot and outputs into a biome data slot.

Welcome to Planet Studio! Here you can build custom planets and planetary systems, then upload and share them with the community.

Planet Studio has two parts: the Celestial Body Designer and the Planetary System Designer. The Celestial Body Designer is where you build any celestial body — planets, suns, moons, dwarf planets, etc. Enter it via the Create Planet or Load Planet buttons in the menu.

The Planetary System Designer is where you build a solar system from celestial bodies saved on your device. Define their orbits and parent/child relationships. Once complete, upload your system to the website and share it with the community. Enter it via the Load System button in the menu.

Both Designers have configurable inputs for camera movement and more, which you can view and configure under Settings -> Control Settings -> Planet Studio.

Note: We often say planet instead of the more correct "celestial body" because it's easier and our fingers are tired from all the typing.

行星工坊分为两部分：天体设计器和行星系设计器。天体设计器用于创建任何天体——行星、恒星、卫星、矮行星等。可通过菜单中的「创建行星」或「加载行星」按钮进入。

行星系设计器则用保存在你设备上的天体搭建恒星系。定义它们的轨道以及父子关系。完成后，把行星系上传到网站并与社区分享。可通过菜单中的「加载行星系」按钮进入。

两个设计器的相机移动等输入都可以配置，你可以在 设置 -> 控制设置 -> 行星工坊 中查看和配置。

注意：我们经常用「行星」代替更准确的「天体」，因为这样更省事，我们的手指也敲累了。

英文原文:
The Noise modifier generates a value using one of several gradient noise functions. This value can set a vertex's height, set a biome's strength, or serve as a mask input to another Noise modifier. The possibilities are endless.

Noise functions are a very complex topic, beyond the scope of this help text. The basics are below, but one of the best ways to learn is to experiment with the different noise types.

Most noise functions use five basic properties: Strength, Frequency, Octaves, Lacunarity, and Gain.

Strength
Strength is the amplitude of the noise, probably the most intuitive setting. Increasing it makes the noise bolder (ie - it outputs larger values).

Frequency
Frequency sets the number of cycles per unit length. In other words, small terrain details need a higher frequency and large details need a lower one.

Octaves
Available for fractal noise, octaves define how many times the noise function runs. With each run, Strength is multiplied by Gain and Frequency by Lacunarity. A common setup is Gain at 0.5 and Lacunarity at 2, so each run halves the strength and doubles the frequency, adding more refined detail at less strength. Increasing octaves can make terrain look great, especially up close, but can also hurt performance, so use them with a hint of caution.

Gain
As noted above, gain multiplies strength for each successive octave. Typically gain is less than one, since you want strength to drop per octave, but working with noise is an art form and sometimes you must break the rules to create truly unique terrain. Experiment and see what looks best!

Lacunarity
Lack-You-Nare-Itty. At least that's how I say it. This multiplies frequency with each octave. Typically you want it above one, so frequency increases per octave and details become tinier and more refined.
当前中文:
噪声修改器使用多种梯度噪声函数之一生成一个值。这个值可以设置顶点的高度、设置生物群系的强度，或作为另一个噪声修改器的遮罩输入。可能性无穷无尽。

噪声函数是一个非常复杂的话题，超出了本帮助文本的范围。下面只介绍基础内容，但最好的学习方式之一是尝试不同的噪声类型。

大多数噪声函数使用五个基本属性：强度、频率、倍频数、间隙度和增益。

强度
强度是噪声的振幅，大概是最直观的设置。调高它会让噪声更强烈（也就是输出更大的值）。

频率
频率设定单位长度内的周期数。换句话说，小的地形细节需要更高的频率，大的细节需要更低的频率。

倍频数
倍频数适用于分形噪声，定义噪声函数运行的次数。每次运行，强度乘以增益，频率乘以间隙度。常见的配置是增益取 0.5、间隙度取 2，这样每次运行强度减半、频率加倍，以更小的强度添加更精细的细节。提高倍频数能让地形更好看，尤其是近看时，但也会影响性能，所以要谨慎使用。

增益
如上所述，增益会为每个后续倍频乘算强度。通常增益小于 1，因为你希望强度逐倍频下降，但处理噪声是一门艺术，有时必须打破规则才能创造出真正独特的地形。多试几次，看看哪种最好看！

间隙度
Lack-You-Nare-Itty，至少我是这么读的。它会为每个倍频乘算频率。通常你会希望它大于 1，这样频率随倍频递增，细节也变得更细小、更精细。

英文原文:
Planet modifiers are grouped into passes. Each pass runs its planet modifiers one at a time before the next pass starts. Passes have different purposes and different input data available.

Biome Pass
The first pass to run. It sets up the biome strength values, laying out where each biome sits on your planet. For example, an earth-like planet would give high biome strength to arctic biomes at the poles and higher strength to deserts and grasslands near the equator.

Height Pass
Runs next, mainly responsible for setting the vertex's height value.

Height Biomes Pass
Runs next for each biome identified in the Biome Pass. If multiple biomes have strength values, they're blended automatically based on their individual strengths. Being biome-specific, this pass is meant for biome-specific modifiers.

Height Final Pass
Runs next, useful for common modifiers that must run after the biome-specific ones. A great place for the RadialFlatten modifier to smooth terrain for structures and launch locations. Not run for individual biomes.

Final Pass
The last pass for the terrain, running after all other terrain passes. It sets any remaining unset vertex data, such as color. This is the only pass where the normal vector is available, and it should not modify the height.

Final Biomes Pass
The Final Pass for biome-specific modifiers. Values are blended based on the strengths from the Biome Pass.

Water Pass
Runs last. Sets water-related data such as color, wave intensity, etc.

Water Biomes Pass
The Water Pass for biome-specific modifiers, with water properties blended based on the strengths from the Biome Pass. This is the last pass to run.

行星修改器按通道分组。每个通道会依次运行其行星修改器，然后下一个通道才开始。各通道有不同用途，可用的输入数据也不同。

生物群系通道
最先运行的通道。它设定生物群系强度值，安排每个生物群系在行星上的位置。例如，类地行星会给极地的极地生物群系很高的生物群系强度，并给赤道附近的沙漠和草原较高强度。

高度通道
接下来运行，主要负责设定顶点的高度值。

高度生物群系通道
接下来为生物群系通道中识别出的每个生物群系运行。若多个生物群系都有强度值，系统会根据各自的强度自动混合。由于针对生物群系，此通道专供生物群系专用修改器使用。

高度最终通道
接下来运行，适合那些必须在生物群系专用修改器之后运行的通用修改器。是放置 RadialFlatten 修改器来为建筑和发射场平整地形的理想位置。不为单个生物群系运行。

最终通道
地形的最后一个通道，在所有其他地形通道之后运行。它设定其余未设置的顶点数据，例如颜色。这是唯一可以使用法线向量的通道，且不应修改高度。

最终生物群系通道
用于生物群系专用修改器的最终通道。数值根据生物群系通道中的强度进行混合。

水面通道
最后运行。设定与水面相关的数据，例如颜色、波浪强度等。

水面生物群系通道
用于生物群系专用修改器的水面通道，水体属性根据生物群系通道中的强度进行混合。这是最后运行的通道。

To make truly unique planets, you'll likely need the Terrain Generation flyout panel. It's the most complicated part of Planet Studio, but also the most powerful.

Terrain generation runs a list of planet modifiers for each terrain vertex. These modifiers calculate the vertex's height, color, texture data, etc.

Terrain Generation has two views: Basic and Advanced. Basic shows only a subset of modifiers, with a simplified inspector panel when selected. Advanced shows all modifiers and all their properties in the inspector. You can also view the Data Flow, which shows how data passes between modifiers; see the Data Flow section for details.

Basic is selected by default, but you can switch modes by tapping the button at the top left of the flyout panel.

地形生成有两种视图：基础和高级。基础视图只显示一部分修改器，选中时显示简化的检查器面板。高级视图显示所有修改器及其在检查器中的全部属性。你还可以查看数据流，它显示数据如何在修改器之间传递；详见数据流一节。

英文原文: Add a new terrain texture to this celestial body.
当前中文: 为此天体添加新的地形贴图。

英文原文: The constant value to add to or subtract from every pixel. Ideally, every texture should average 0.5 (from 0 to 1). A lower or higher average can greatly impact the average brightness of the terrain using that texture. This setting adjusts that average color if the source texture is too bright or dim.
当前中文: 加到或减去每个像素的常量值。理想情况下，每张贴图的平均值应为 0.5（范围 0 到 1）。平均值偏低或偏高会大幅影响使用该贴图的地形整体亮度。当源贴图过亮或过暗时，此设置可调整该平均颜色。

英文原文: Detail textures brighten or darken the terrain when above or below the 0.5 color value (range 0 to 1). This setting multiplies the difference between the pixel value and 0.5, effectively magnifying the texture's details.
当前中文: 当高于或低于 0.5 颜色值（范围 0 到 1）时，细节贴图会提亮或压暗地形。此设置会乘算像素值与 0.5 的差值，从而放大贴图的细节。

英文原文: Convert the texture to grayscale before sampling the red channel for the detail texture value used at runtime.
当前中文: 在运行时采样红色通道以获取细节贴图值之前，先把贴图转换为灰度。

英文原文: Removes the last texture from this celestial body.
当前中文: 从此天体移除最后一张贴图。
每面缩放 UV 尺寸

英文原文: The base UV scale for the celestial body when the camera is near the surface. This shared setting affects both terrain and water. Texture mapping uses two UV sets: scaled UVs near the surface and non-scaled UVs farther away. The tiling level for non-scaled UVs is how many times the texture repeats over each of the planet's six faces. For scaled UVs, the tiling level is multiplied by this scaled UV size to get the repeat count. So if this is 256 and a scaled UV level's tiling is 2, the actual tiling for that level is 512.
当前中文: 相机靠近表面时天体的基础 UV 缩放。此共享设置同时影响地形与水面。贴图映射使用两套 UV：靠近表面的缩放 UV，以及较远处的非缩放 UV。非缩放 UV 的平铺层级是指贴图在行星六个面上各自重复的次数。对于缩放 UV，平铺层级会乘以该缩放 UV 尺寸以得到重复次数。例如，若此值为 256，某缩放 UV 层级的平铺为 2，则该层级的实际平铺数为 512。

英文原文: The strength of the texture at this level (typically from 0 to 1).
当前中文: 该层级上贴图的强度（通常为 0 到 1）。

英文原文: One of the terrain textures used by the celestial body — up to 8 per body. Textures must be added here first, then selected on the Biomes flyout to choose where they're used on the surface. They act as detail textures, brightening and darkening the surface's base color. Only a single channel (red) is used: red values above 0.5 (on a 0 to 1 scale) brighten the terrain color, and values below darken it.
当前中文: 天体使用的地形贴图之一——每个天体最多 8 张。贴图必须先在此外添加，然后在生物群系面板中选用，以决定它们在地表的使用位置。它们作为细节贴图，提亮或压暗表面的基础颜色。只使用一个通道（红色）：红色值高于 0.5（0 到 1 尺度）会提亮地形颜色，低于则压暗。

英文原文: The distance adjustment value added to the distance that determines the tiling level. It is applied after the distance scalar.\n\nExample: If the first tiling level lasts until about 100 meters and this adjustment is -500, the first tiling level will last until about 600 meters.
当前中文: 加到用于决定平铺层级的距离上的距离调整值。它在距离标量之后应用。\n\n示例：若第一平铺层级持续到约 100 米，而此调整为 -500，则第一平铺层级会持续到约 600 米。

英文原文: The distance scalar used to adjust the distance at which tiling levels begin. Doubling this value makes tiling levels begin twice as early as normal.
当前中文: 用于调整平铺层级起始距离的距离标量。将此值加倍会让平铺层级比正常提前一倍开始。

英文原文: The tiling level at which textures switch from regular UVs to scaled UVs. Texture mapping uses two UV sets: scaled UVs closer to the surface and non-scaled UVs farther away. The non-scaled tiling level is how many times the texture repeats over each of the planet's six faces. The scaled tiling level is multiplied by the scaled UV size to give how many times the texture repeats.
当前中文: 贴图从常规 UV 切换为缩放 UV 的平铺层级。贴图映射使用两套 UV：靠近表面的缩放 UV，以及较远处的非缩放 UV。非缩放平铺层级是指贴图在行星六个面上各自重复的次数。缩放平铺层级则乘以缩放 UV 尺寸，得到贴图重复的次数。

英文原文: The amount of tiling to apply to textures at this level. Lower levels are shown closer to the ground so more tiling is needed.
当前中文: 该层级上应用到贴图的平铺量。层级越低，离地面越近，因此需要更多平铺。

英文原文: The strength of the texture at this level.

The strength of the water's normal map textures, typically 0 to 1. Strength can change as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer, with the top being closest.
当前中文: 水的法线贴图强度，通常为 0 到 1。强度会随相机接近表面而变化。此表中从下到上的每项代表相机逐渐靠近，最上面一项表示最近。

英文原文: The texture tiling level for the water's normal map textures. Tiling changes as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer, with the top being closest. 当前中文: 水法线贴图的平铺层级。平铺会随相机接近表面而变化。此表中从下到上的每项代表相机逐渐靠近，最上面一项表示最近。在中间某处，根据地形 splatmap 的设置，UV 缩放会改变，因此此处的平铺层级也必须随之改变以作补偿。

英文原文: The speed of the water's normal map textures (not the actual waves). Speed can change as the camera nears the surface. Each entry in this table, from bottom to top, represents the camera getting closer to the surface, with the top entry being closest.
当前中文: 水的法线贴图速度（并非实际波浪）。速度会随相机接近表面而变化。此表中从下到上的每项代表相机逐渐靠近表面，最上面一项表示最近。

英文原文: The intensity of the underwater color.

当前中文: 水的自发光。自发光为 100% 时，水不受光线影响。

当前中文: 极浅水中叠加在反射/折射之上的水面泡沫颜色。

英文原文: The maximum depth at which foam is applied.
The strength of the foam color.

当前中文: 距相机多远（米）时水下能见度开始衰减。

英文原文: The metallicness of the water from a visual standpoint.

英文原文: The higher the value, the more distortion in transparent water due to refraction.

当前中文: 调整载具细节贴图的质量。这些贴图通过明暗变化在载具零件上呈现图案。

当前中文: 单个载具同时亮灯的最大数量。超过上限时，优先保留最近开启的灯。

英文原文: Normal maps will not be used for craft parts.
当前中文: 载具零件不使用法线贴图。
