当前中文: 载具零件的法线贴图将使用高分辨率贴图。

英文原文: Low resolution textures will be used for the normal maps on craft parts.
当前中文: 载具零件的法线贴图将使用低分辨率贴图。

英文原文: Medium resolution textures will be used for the normal maps on craft parts.
当前中文: 载具零件的法线贴图将使用中分辨率贴图。

英文原文: This setting adjusts the quality of the craft normal maps. Normal maps affect lighting and make the parts appear more detailed.
当前中文: 调整载具法线贴图的质量。法线贴图会影响光照，让零件看起来更精细。

英文原文: This setting changes the way reflections are handled on the craft surfaces.
当前中文: 更改载具表面反射的处理方式。

英文原文: Adjusts the sensitivity of panning the view side to side in the designer.
当前中文: 调整设计器中左右平移视角的灵敏度。

英文原文: Adjusts the sensitivity of rotating the view in the designer.
当前中文: 调整设计器中旋转视角的灵敏度。

英文原文: Adjusts the sensitivity of zooming the view in/out in the designer.
当前中文: 调整设计器中拉近拉远视角的灵敏度。

英文原文: Shows a small interactive view cube in the designer. Click it to snap the camera to standard orthographic views, or drag it to rotate the camera freely.
当前中文: 在设计器中显示一个小型交互视图立方体。点击可将摄像机切换到标准正交视图，拖动可自由旋转摄像机。

英文原文: Adjusts the on-screen size of the designer navigation cube.
当前中文: 调整设计器导航立方体在屏幕上的大小。

英文原文: You have pending changes in the current tab.\n\nPlease discard or apply changes before switching tabs.
当前中文: 当前标签页中有未应用的更改。\n\n请先放弃或应用更改，然后再切换标签页。

英文原文: Toggles the option of rendering the game in fullscreen mode or windowed mode.
当前中文: 切换游戏以全屏模式或窗口模式渲染。

英文原文: Reducing the resolution can improve performance and battery life, but at the cost of reduced visual quality.
当前中文: 降低分辨率可提升性能并延长续航，但会牺牲画面质量。

英文原文: Uses V-Sync to lock the game's framerate to the monitor's refresh rate, preventing screen tearing. Also improves battery life and reduces overheating on laptops and mobile devices.
当前中文: 使用垂直同步将游戏帧率锁定到显示器刷新率，防止画面撕裂。在笔记本电脑和移动设备上还能延长续航并减少发热。

英文原文: Limits the maximum refresh rate of the game to improve battery life and reduce overheating.
当前中文: 限制游戏的最大刷新率，以延长续航并减少发热。

英文原文: Setting the refresh rate above your monitor's native rate may cause instability.
当前中文: 将刷新率设置得高于显示器原生刷新率可能导致不稳定。

英文原文: The resolution at which the game is rendered.
当前中文: 游戏渲染所使用的分辨率。

英文原文: Renders the game scene at a smaller resolution than the current one. This keeps the UI high resolution while reducing the game's overall graphical resolution.
当前中文: 以低于当前分辨率的尺寸渲染游戏场景。这样可降低整体画面分辨率，同时保持界面清晰。

英文原文: Sets the quality of physics colliders for debris pieces.
当前中文: 设置残骸碎片的物理碰撞体质量。

英文原文: Colliders will be disabled for explosion debris. It will just fall right through stuff, but will be faster.
当前中文: 爆炸残骸将禁用碰撞体。它们会直接穿过物体，但性能更好。

英文原文: Explosions debris will contain a physics collider. It won't fall through objects.
当前中文: 爆炸残骸将带有物理碰撞体，不会穿过物体。

英文原文: The lifetime (in seconds) of explosion debris.
当前中文: 爆炸残骸的存在时间（秒）。

英文原文: We will discard pieces that are smaller than a certain size (which is determined by this setting).
当前中文: 小于一定尺寸的碎片会被丢弃（该尺寸由本设置决定）。

英文原文: Only the smaller debris will be discarded.
Debris are aggressively discarded, including medium and some larger pieces.
当前中文: 大幅丢弃残骸，包括中等和部分较大的碎片。

英文原文: Fewer large debris are discarded, but some medium pieces still are.
当前中文: 丢弃的较大残骸更少，但仍会丢弃部分中等碎片。

英文原文: Similar to high setting except some parts which would never have debris will have it now.
当前中文: 与「高」类似，但一些原本不会产生残骸的零件现在也会产生。

英文原文: Controls the size and number of pieces parts will explode into. Larger pieces means there are fewer of them and therefore increases performance.
当前中文: 控制零件爆炸后产生的碎片大小与数量。碎片越大则数量越少，性能越好。

英文原文: Parts will fracture into fewer, large parts.
当前中文: 零件会碎成较少的大块。

英文原文: Parts will fracture into more, smaller parts.
当前中文: 零件会碎成更多的小块。

英文原文: Exploded parts will not fracture into smaller pieces.
当前中文: 爆炸的零件不会碎成小块。

英文原文: Parts will fracture into many, even smaller parts.
当前中文: 零件会碎成许多更小的块。

英文原文: Sets the quality of the particle effects for explosion debris.
当前中文: 设置爆炸残骸粒子效果的质量。

英文原文: Sets the frequency at which particle effects are added to explosion debris. WARNING: Increasing this can severely impact performance.
当前中文: 设置爆炸残骸附加粒子效果的频率。警告：提高此项会严重影响性能。

英文原文: Increase the number of particle effects in small increments to see how your system handles it. It has a large impact on performance and could make the game unresponsive.
当前中文: 请小幅提高粒子效果数量，观察系统能否承受。它对性能影响很大，可能导致游戏无响应。

英文原文: Sets how often lights are added to particle effects. This can severely impact performance and may require reducing the particle effect frequency. WARNING: Increasing this can severely impact performance.
当前中文: 设置粒子效果附加灯光的频率。这会严重影响性能，可能需要降低粒子效果频率。警告：提高此项会严重影响性能。

英文原文: Increase the number of lights in small increments to see how your system handles it. It has a large performance impact and could make the game unresponsive.
当前中文: 请小幅提高灯光数量，观察系统能否承受。它对性能影响很大，可能导致游戏无响应。

英文原文: Higher quality shader that responds to light conditions and have volumetric effects.
当前中文: 更高质量的着色器，可响应光照条件并具有体积效果。

英文原文: A less taxing particle effect shader.
当前中文: 负载更低的粒子效果着色器。

英文原文: Adjusts the strength of the ambient lighting at night.
当前中文: 调整夜间环境光的强度。

英文原文: Enables or disables ambient light attenuation. When enabled, ambient light is only applied to an area centered on the game camera, falling off to nothing in the distance.
当前中文: 启用或禁用环境光衰减。启用后，环境光仅作用于以游戏摄像机为中心的区域，并随距离逐渐消失。

英文原文: Adjusts the strength of the ambient lighting in space.
当前中文: 调整太空中环境光的强度。

英文原文: Adjusts the sensitivity of the flight camera.
当前中文: 调整飞行摄像机的灵敏度。

英文原文: Adjusts the strength of the camera shake in flight.
当前中文: 调整飞行中摄像机抖动的强度。

英文原文: Adjusts the rotation speed of the flight camera. The higher this is, the less 'floaty' the camera will feel.
当前中文: 调整飞行摄像机的旋转速度。数值越高，摄像机越不「飘」。

英文原文: Adjusts the smoothing of the chase camera.
当前中文: 调整追尾摄像机的平滑程度。

英文原文: Adjusts the fast forward speed. Setting this too high can cause performance problems during fast forward. This setting does not impact warp speeds.
当前中文: 调整快进速度。设置过高会导致快进时出现性能问题。本设置不影响时间加速速度。

英文原文: Increasing the fast forward speed reduces framerate while fast forwarding. Smaller crafts may not be hit much, but larger ones can drop framerate severely. Lowering the "Physics Update Frequency" setting allows higher fast forward with less framerate drop. This setting doesn't affect framerate during warping.
当前中文: 提高快进速度会降低快进时的帧率。小型载具受影响较小，但大型载具的帧率可能大幅下降。降低「物理更新频率」设置可在帧率下降更少的前提下使用更高的快进速度。本设置不影响时间加速时的帧率。

英文原文: Adjusts the smoothing of the first-person camera when controlling an astronaut.
当前中文: 调整操控宇航员时第一人称摄像机的平滑程度。

英文原文: Adjusts the sensitivity of the first-person camera when controlling an astronaut.
当前中文: 调整操控宇航员时第一人称摄像机的灵敏度。

英文原文: Adjusts the strength of the stars in the background.
The field of view used by most of the game cameras.
当前中文: 游戏中大多数摄像机所使用的视场角。

当前中文: 决定游戏如何将错误、警告和其他日志消息记录到文件。

当前中文: 加载界面期间，所有日志消息都会被记录并写入文件。

英文原文: Errors and warnings will be recorded and logged to a file during loading screens.
当前中文: 加载界面期间，错误和警告会被记录并写入文件。

英文原文: No file logging will occur after the game is initialized.
当前中文: 游戏初始化后不再写入日志文件。

英文原文: All log messages will be recorded and logged to a file as they are received.
当前中文: 所有日志消息在产生时即被记录并写入文件。

英文原文: If enabled, the game will continue to run while minimized or not in focus.
当前中文: 启用后，游戏在最小化或失去焦点时仍会继续运行。

当前中文: 针对带有刘海或圆角的设备，让界面远离屏幕左右边缘。

英文原文: This setting pulls in the UI from the top and bottom edges of the screen for devices that have notches or curved corners.
当前中文: 针对带有刘海或圆角的设备，让界面远离屏幕上下边缘。

英文原文: UI Preferences have been reset. Reload the current scene for the changes to take effect.
当前中文: 界面偏好已重置。重新加载当前场景后更改才会生效。

英文原文: Increases or decreases the size of the user interface.
当前中文: 增大或减小用户界面的大小。

当前中文: 环境光遮蔽的强度。它会在复杂几何体上渲染柔和阴影，让场景看起来更真实。

当前中文: 更改变形光晕的强度。0% 表示关闭。

当前中文: 更改泛光的强度。0% 表示关闭。

当前中文: 开关 HDR。HDR 会显著影响内存占用和性能。

英文原文: Changes the intensity of the sun flare. Zero percent is off.
当前中文: 更改太阳光晕的强度。0% 表示关闭。

当前中文: 启用后，鼠标摇杆的俯仰轴将被反转。在「载具飞行」设置中为「开关鼠标摇杆」分配按键即可启用鼠标摇杆。

英文原文: The deadzone percent of the screen where the mouse joystick pitch input is zero. Enable the mouse joystick by assigning a button to Toggle Mouse Joystick in Flight Craft settings.
当前中文: 屏幕中鼠标摇杆俯仰输入为零的死区百分比。在「载具飞行」设置中为「开关鼠标摇杆」分配按键即可启用鼠标摇杆。

英文原文: The deadzone percent of the screen where mouse joystick roll input is zero. Enable the mouse joystick by assigning a button to Toggle Mouse Joystick in Flight Craft settings.
当前中文: 屏幕中鼠标摇杆滚转输入为零的死区百分比。在「载具飞行」设置中为「开关鼠标摇杆」分配按键即可启用鼠标摇杆。

英文原文: The mouse button(s) used to select parts.
当前中文: 用于选择零件的鼠标按键。

英文原文: The mouse input(s) used to spin the camera around its forward axis.
当前中文: 用于绕摄像机前方轴旋转摄像机的鼠标输入。

英文原文: This lets physics simulation slow down instead of dropping framerate. When enabled, craft may appear to slow during intense physics like crashes, or often if a very large craft is loaded.
当前中文: 让物理模拟放慢速度，而不是降低帧率。启用后，在碰撞等剧烈物理过程中，或加载超大载具时，载具可能看起来变慢。

英文原文: Same as default, except reduction will kick in sooner. This may result in a smoother frame-rate on faster computers, but may excessively slow down physics simulation on slower computers.
当前中文: 与默认相同，但会更早开始抑制。在较快的电脑上帧率可能更平滑，但在较慢的电脑上可能过度拖慢物理模拟。

英文原文: During extreme lag spikes, the physics simulation speed will be slowed to allow the frame-rate to recover.
当前中文: 出现严重卡顿时，物理模拟速度会放慢，以便帧率恢复。

英文原文: Physics simulation will not be slowed down. As a result, you may experience extreme frame-rate dips with larger craft.
当前中文: 物理模拟不会放慢。因此使用较大载具时可能遇到帧率骤降。

英文原文: When enabled, non-wing parts can receive lift forces in addition to drag forces. When disabled, non-wing parts will only receive drag forces.
当前中文: 启用后，非机翼零件除阻力外还能受到升力。禁用后，非机翼零件只受到阻力。

英文原文: The distance in meters at which other craft's physics become enabled. Note that craft loaded in far from the active craft can jitter and become unstable.
当前中文: 其他载具启用物理模拟的距离（米）。注意：在远离当前载具处加载的载具可能抖动并变得不稳定。

英文原文: The default update frequency. All craft should perform as the designer intended.
当前中文: 默认更新频率。所有载具的表现都应符合设计者的预期。

英文原文: Best performance, but some craft may not perform as the designer intended. Craft may exhibit structural issues, especially load-bearing parts like custom landing gear.
当前中文: 性能最佳，但部分载具的表现可能不符合设计者的预期。载具可能出现结构问题，尤其是自定义起落架等承重零件。

英文原文: The majority of craft should perform as the designer intended.
当前中文: 大多数载具的表现都应符合设计者的预期。

英文原文: The highest update frequency, but the most CPU intensive. Larger craft may significantly drop the frame-rate even on fast computers.
当前中文: 最高的更新频率，但最耗 CPU。即使是较快的电脑，大型载具也可能显著降低帧率。

英文原文: Sets the quality of the rag-doll physics simulation.
当前中文: 设置布娃娃物理模拟的质量。
标准的布娃娃质量设置。

英文原文: Same as normal except rag-doll animations are updated in sync with physics cycles. Prevents rag-doll from separating during extreme maneuvers. Very taxing with multiple rag-dolls, and not recommended.
当前中文: 与标准相同，但布娃娃动画与物理周期同步更新，可防止极限机动时布娃娃散开。多个布娃娃同时存在时负载很高，不推荐使用。

英文原文: Sets the frequency of physics updates. The physics simulation gets more accurate at higher settings. Adjusting this setting has large implications to performance and physics accuracy.
当前中文: 设置物理更新的频率。设置越高，物理模拟越精确。调整此项对性能和物理精度影响很大。

英文原文: Sets the quality of the water physics simulation.
当前中文: 设置水体物理模拟的质量。

英文原文: Further number crunching is performed to make things more stable when resting at the surface.
当前中文: 进行更多运算，让物体静止于水面时更稳定。

英文原文: Bare minimum is done to get things to float. Craft may bounce and wobble on the surface more, and we won't calculate precise submerged percentages. Forces are applied per rigid body.
当前中文: 仅进行让物体浮起来的最低限度运算。载具在水面上可能更易弹跳晃动，也不会计算精确的浸没比例。作用力按刚体施加。

英文原文: Additional processing is done to give precise submerged percentages. Forces are applied per-part.
当前中文: 进行额外运算以给出精确的浸没比例。作用力按零件施加。

英文原文: Some settings won't take effect until the next time you start the game.
当前中文: 部分设置需要下次启动游戏后才会生效。

英文原文: Some settings won't take effect until the next time a planet is loaded.
当前中文: 部分设置需要下次加载行星后才会生效。

英文原文: Some settings won't take effect until the next time the designer or solar system is loaded.
当前中文: 部分设置需要下次加载设计器或星系后才会生效。

英文原文: Indicates whether the craft's light parts will create shadows.
当前中文: 指示载具的灯具零件是否会投射阴影。

英文原文: The platform in the designer will receive shadows cast by the craft parts.
当前中文: 设计器中的平台会接收载具零件投射的阴影。

英文原文: Higher values give higher detail on close-ups but a shorter shadow distance when zooming in; lower values keep the larger distance at the cost of shadow resolution.
当前中文: 数值越高，近景细节越多，但拉近时阴影距离更短；数值越低，阴影距离越远，但会牺牲阴影分辨率。

英文原文: Craft parts will cast and receive shadows if enabled.
当前中文: 启用后，载具零件会投射并接收阴影。

英文原文: Adjusts the maximum distance at which shadows are drawn. This also affects the resolution of the shadows.
当前中文: 调整绘制阴影的最大距离。这也会影响阴影的分辨率。

英文原文: High resolution shadows with far maximum draw distances.
当前中文: 高分辨率阴影，最大绘制距离远。

英文原文: Low resolution shadows with short maximum draw distances.
当前中文: 低分辨率阴影，最大绘制距离近。

英文原文: Medium resolution shadows with moderate maximum draw distances.
当前中文: 中等分辨率阴影，最大绘制距离适中。

英文原文: Same maximum draw distance as 'High' but uses higher resolution shadows if the GPU supports it.
当前中文: 最大绘制距离与「高」相同，但在 GPU 支持时使用更高分辨率的阴影。

英文原文: The terrain will receive shadows cast by craft parts and other objects.
当前中文: 地形会接收载具零件和其他物体投射的阴影。

英文原文: All cloud layers are combined onto a single sphere and cast shadows on themselves and the terrain.
当前中文: 所有云层合并到一个球体上，并会在自身和地形上投射阴影。

英文原文: All cloud layers are combined onto a single sphere with no shadows.
当前中文: 所有云层合并到一个球体上，不投射阴影。

英文原文: Each cloud layer is rendered on its own sphere and they cast shadows on themselves and the terrain.
当前中文: 每层云各自渲染在自己的球体上，并会在自身和地形上投射阴影。

英文原文: Controls the fake cloud layers drawn on distant planets in flight and map view. These clouds are only visible from far away (in scaled space) and never from the surface. Higher settings add cloud shadows on the clouds and the terrain, and render each layer on its own sphere, at the cost of performance.
当前中文: 控制飞行和地图视图中远处行星上绘制的假云层。这些云只在远处（缩放空间中）可见，从地表永远看不到。更高的设置会为云层和地形添加云影，并将每层云渲染到各自的球体上，代价是性能下降。

英文原文: Your current Fake Clouds setting renders each cloud layer on its own sphere and may noticeably lower the frame rate on this device. Lower it if performance suffers.
当前中文: 当前「假云」设置会将每层云渲染到各自的球体上，在此设备上可能明显降低帧率。如果性能不足，请调低该设置。

英文原文: The detail level used when generating and rendering the terrain geometry. This can have large impacts on performance.
当前中文: 生成和渲染地形几何体时使用的细节等级。这可能对性能有很大影响。

英文原文: Use the highest setting for the terrain's geometric detail. This may greatly increase terrain load time, memory consumption, and render speed, depending on the planet.
当前中文: 地形几何细节使用最高设置。视行星而定，这可能大幅增加地形加载时间、内存占用与渲染开销。

英文原文: Use the lowest setting for the terrain's geometric detail. This helps reduce terrain load time, memory consumption, and render speed, but could be different for each planet.
当前中文: 地形几何细节使用最低设置。这有助于减少地形加载时间、内存占用与渲染开销，但每个行星的情况可能各不相同。

英文原文: Use the medium setting for the terrain's geometric detail.
当前中文: 地形几何细节使用中等设置。

英文原文: This affects the distances at which higher-detail terrain loads. Higher values show more terrain detail at a given distance from the surface. Increasing this can have very large performance and memory impacts.
当前中文: 影响更高细节地形的加载距离。数值越高，在离地表同样距离处显示的地形细节越多。提高此项会对性能和内存产生很大影响。

英文原文: The maximum number of particles that may be alive simultaneously across all flight-scene effects (engine smoke, terrain dust, sparks).
当前中文: 飞行场景中所有效果（发动机烟雾、地面扬尘、火花）可同时存在的最大粒子数。

英文原文: Low resolution textures and normal maps will be used for distant planets and map view planets. Higher resolutions textures will be used for the current planet (in flight and map view) as well as on the main menu.
当前中文: 远处行星和地图视图行星将使用低分辨率贴图和法线贴图。当前行星（飞行与地图视图中）以及主菜单将使用更高分辨率的贴图。

英文原文: Low resolution textures will be used for distant planets, map view planets, and the main menu planet. Normal mapping will not be used.
当前中文: 远处行星、地图视图行星和主菜单行星将使用低分辨率贴图，且不使用法线贴图。

英文原文: Low resolution textures and normal maps will be used for distant planets, map view planets, and the main menu planet.
当前中文: 远处行星、地图视图行星和主菜单行星将使用低分辨率贴图和法线贴图。

英文原文: This is going to use 8k textures, are you even sure you want to? Generating them will take a while so better leave it running overnight. Make sure you have at least 6GB of VRAM in your GPU for the stock systems, more for larger ones, or you will get frequent crashes.
当前中文: 这将使用 8k 贴图，你确定要这么做吗？生成它们需要一段时间，最好让它跑一整夜。请确保你的 GPU 至少有 6GB 显存（原版星系），更大的星系需要更多，否则会频繁崩溃。

英文原文: Low resolution textures including cliffs and normal maps will be used for distant planets and map view planets. 2k resolution textures will be used for the current planet (in flight and map view), and high resolution textures in the main menu. This can be incredibly slow, especially in low end devices, taking up to hours and requiring loads of ram, vram and disk space.
当前中文: 远处行星和地图视图行星将使用低分辨率贴图（包括悬崖贴图和法线贴图）。当前行星（飞行与地图视图中）将使用 2k 分辨率贴图，主菜单使用高分辨率贴图。这可能非常慢，尤其是在低端设备上，可能耗时数小时，并占用大量内存、显存与磁盘空间。

英文原文: Low resolution textures including cliffs and normal maps will be used for distant planets and map view planets. 4k resolution textures will be used for the current planet (in flight and map view), and high resolution textures in the main menu. This can be incredibly slow, especially in low end devices, taking up to hours and requiring loads of ram, vram and disk space.
当前中文: 远处行星和地图视图行星将使用低分辨率贴图（包括悬崖贴图和法线贴图）。当前行星（飞行与地图视图中）将使用 4k 分辨率贴图，主菜单使用高分辨率贴图。这可能非常慢，尤其是在低端设备上，可能耗时数小时，并占用大量内存、显存与磁盘空间。

英文原文: Low resolution textures including cliffs and normal maps will be used for distant planets and map view planets. Very high resolution textures will be used for the current planet (in flight and map view), and high in the main menu. This can be incredibly slow, especially in low end devices, taking up to hours and requiring loads of ram, vram and disk space.
当前中文: 远处行星和地图视图中的行星将使用低分辨率贴图，包括崖壁与法线贴图。当前行星（飞行与地图视图中）使用极高分辨率贴图，主菜单中则使用高分辨率。这会极其缓慢，尤其在低端设备上，可能需要数小时，并占用大量内存、显存和磁盘空间。

英文原文: This adjusts the quality of planet cubemaps. These are used to render distant planets, planets in map view, and the planet on the main menu.
当前中文: 调整行星立方体贴图的质量。它们用于渲染远处行星、地图视图中的行星，以及主菜单中的行星。

英文原文: Your current Planet Cubemaps setting will cause hours of loading screens and likely crash your device. Please lower it back if you don't know what you're doing.
当前中文: 当前的行星立方体贴图设置会导致数小时的加载画面，并很可能让设备崩溃。如果不清楚自己在做什么，请调回较低的设置。

英文原文: Your current Planet Cubemaps setting will lead to hours of loading screens and likely crash your device, is it worth it?
当前中文: 当前的行星立方体贴图设置会导致数小时的加载画面，并很可能让设备崩溃，值得吗？

英文原文: Your current Planet Cubemaps setting will lead a long loading screen the first time you go into flight, get some popcorn ready.
当前中文: 当前的行星立方体贴图设置会让你首次进入飞行时面对漫长的加载画面，准备好爆米花吧。

英文原文: The quality level for in-flight particle effects: engine smoke, terrain dust, and sparks.
当前中文: 飞行中粒子效果的质量等级：发动机烟雾、地形尘土和火花。

英文原文: The detail level used when loading structures on the terrain.
当前中文: 在地形上加载建筑时使用的细节等级。

英文原文: All components of structures will be loaded.
当前中文: 将加载建筑的所有组件。

英文原文: Only required components of structures will be loaded.
当前中文: 仅加载建筑必需的组件。

英文原文: Most components of structures will be loaded.
当前中文: 将加载建筑的大部分组件。

英文原文: Terrain related structures (like launchpads, runways, and buildings) will not be normal mapped.
当前中文: 与地形相关的建筑（如发射台、跑道和房屋）将不使用法线贴图。

英文原文: Terrain related structures (like launchpads, runways, and buildings) will use normal mapping whenever possible.
当前中文: 与地形相关的建筑（如发射台、跑道和房屋）将尽可能使用法线贴图。

英文原文: Enables or disables normal mapping on terrain related structures, like the launch pad, runways, and buildings.
当前中文: 启用或禁用与地形相关建筑（如发射台、跑道和房屋）的法线贴图。

英文原文: A large number of particles are emitted by each spawner.
当前中文: 每个发射器会喷出大量粒子。

英文原文: A low number of particles are emitted by each spawner.
当前中文: 每个发射器会喷出少量粒子。

英文原文: A moderate number of particles are emitted by each spawner.
当前中文: 每个发射器会喷出中等数量的粒子。

英文原文: The maximum number of particles are emitted by each spawner.
当前中文: 每个发射器会喷出最大数量的粒子。

英文原文: High quality distance blending will be used for textures applied to the planet's surface. This provides the best surface detail but may be slower than the other approach.
当前中文: 应用到行星表面的贴图将使用高质量的远距混合。这能提供最佳的表面细节，但可能比其他方式更慢。

英文原文: Distance blending will be used for textures applied to the planet's surface. This approach could result in some visual artifacts between blending levels.
当前中文: 应用到行星表面的贴图将使用远距混合。这种方式可能在混合层级之间产生一些视觉瑕疵。

英文原文: Textures will not be applied to planet surfaces.
当前中文: 不会将贴图应用到行星表面。

英文原文: The texture mapping approach used when rendering planet surfaces.
当前中文: 渲染行星表面时使用的贴图映射方式。

英文原文: The game may collect data for the developers to analyze and improve the gameplay experience. You may opt out of this by disabling this setting.
当前中文: 游戏可能会收集数据，供开发者分析并改善游戏体验。你可以禁用此设置来选择不参与。

英文原文: This game may collect anonymous data to help improve the gameplay experience. We need your consent to collect it. We totally understand if you'd prefer not to participate, and you can change your choice anytime in the game settings. Please select an option below.
当前中文: 本游戏可能会收集匿名数据以帮助改善游戏体验。我们需要你的同意才能收集。我们完全理解你不想参与，你随时可以在游戏设置中更改选择。请在下方选择一个选项。

英文原文: You have chosen to opt out of analytics. They will remain disabled until you choose to opt back in.
当前中文: 你已选择不参与数据分析。在你重新选择参与之前，它将保持禁用。

英文原文: You have not yet made a choice regarding analytics. They will remain disabled until you choose to opt in.
当前中文: 你尚未就数据分析做出选择。在你选择参与之前，它将保持禁用。

英文原文: You have chosen to opt in to analytics. Anonymous data may be collected to improve the gameplay experience.
当前中文: 你已选择参与数据分析。可能会收集匿名数据以改善游戏体验。

英文原文: Click this button to modify your privacy preferences in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
当前中文: 点击此按钮，依照《通用数据保护条例》(GDPR) 修改你的隐私偏好。

英文原文: Anisotropic filtering will never be used. Textures can look blurry at steep viewing angles.
当前中文: 永不使用各向异性过滤。在倾斜的观察角度下贴图可能显得模糊。

英文原文: Anisotropic filtering will always be used. This improves the look of textures at steep viewing angles.
当前中文: 始终使用各向异性过滤。这可改善倾斜观察角度下贴图的观感。

英文原文: Anisotropic filtering will be used for some textures but not all textures. For those textures that use it, this improves the look of the textures at steep viewing angles.
当前中文: 部分贴图会使用各向异性过滤，并非全部贴图。对于使用它的贴图，可改善倾斜观察角度下的观感。

英文原文: Sets the quality of the atmospheres rendering.
High quality atmosphere rendering effects are applied.
当前中文: 应用高质量的大气渲染效果。

英文原文: Low quality atmosphere rendering effects are applied.
当前中文: 应用低质量的大气渲染效果。

英文原文: Atmosphere rendering effects are not applied.
A much more subdivided mesh is used, removing tessellation on the atmosphere edge.
当前中文: 使用细分程度高得多的网格，消除大气边缘的镶嵌感。
设计器光照质量零件阈值

英文原文: If the designer's part count exceeds this threshold, the secondary directional light (pointing up from the bottom) reduces its quality to boost framerate.
当前中文: 如果设计器中的零件数超过此阈值，次级平行光（自下方向上照射）会降低质量以提升帧率。

英文原文: Explosions will have all visual effects, including a point light and a shockwave.
当前中文: 爆炸将具有全部视觉效果，包括点光源和冲击波。

英文原文: Explosions will have minimal visual effects.
当前中文: 爆炸将只有最基本的视觉效果。

英文原文: Explosions will have most visual effects except for the most taxing.
当前中文: 爆炸将具有大部分视觉效果，但不含最耗性能的那些。

英文原文: Sets the visual quality of explosions.
Enables or disables heat distortion effects on jet engines.
当前中文: 启用或禁用喷气发动机的热扭曲效果。

英文原文: Sets whether the steam from the launch pad is rendered.
当前中文: 设置是否渲染发射台的蒸汽。

英文原文: The lighting quality changes the accuracy of how light is applied to most surfaces in the game.
当前中文: 光照质量会改变游戏中大多数表面受光的准确程度。

英文原文: High quality lighting can improve the overall look of the game but it increases graphical load and can decrease framerate on weaker GPUs.
当前中文: 高质量光照可改善游戏的整体观感，但会增加图形负载，并可能降低性能较弱 GPU 的帧率。

英文原文: Low quality lighting reduces graphical load and can improve framerate on weaker GPUs.
当前中文: 低质量光照可降低图形负载，并提升性能较弱 GPU 的帧率。

英文原文: Sets the visual quality of the sun in the main menu.
当前中文: 设置主菜单中太阳的视觉质量。

英文原文: The sun in the main menu will be as fancy as we can make it.
当前中文: 主菜单中的太阳会尽可能华丽。

英文原文: The sun in the main menu will not be very fancy.
当前中文: 主菜单中的太阳不会很华丽。

当前中文: 点击左侧的零件属性按钮。

英文原文: Click the red button to show the Center of Mass indicator as a red ball.
当前中文: 点击红色按钮，把质心指示器显示为红色小球。

英文原文: Click the blue button to show the Center of Lift indicator as a blue ball.
当前中文: 点击蓝色按钮，把升力中心指示器显示为蓝色小球。

英文原文: Click the View Options button on the left.
当前中文: 点击左侧的视图选项按钮。

英文原文: Tap the Finger Tool button in the bottom right.
当前中文: 点击右下角的手指工具按钮。

英文原文: Congratulations on starting your own aerospace company! It's a tough business, but with my connections I can help you succeed. Please, allow me to introduce myself: I am Algernon Fizzlebottom.
当前中文: 恭喜你创立了自己的航天公司！这行很难做，但凭我的人脉可以助你成功。请允许我自我介绍：我是阿尔杰农·菲兹尔博顿。

英文原文: I recently inherited my grandfather's research company and own many technology patents. I don't have time to chase the stars myself, so I'm offering incentives to help new aerospace companies get started. Let's go to the Tech Tree and see what I can offer you.
当前中文: 我最近继承了祖父的研究公司，拥有许多技术专利。我自己没时间去追逐星辰，所以愿意提供奖励，帮助新的航天公司起步。我们去科技树看看我能给你什么。

英文原文: Welcome to the Tech Tree. Click '{0}' to see what technologies it contains, then click Unlock. This one won't cost any Tech Points, so it's a great bargain.
当前中文: 欢迎来到科技树。点击「{0}」查看其中包含的技术，然后点击解锁。这个不需要科技点，非常划算。

英文原文: Fantastic! Now unlock '{0}'. It is also free.
当前中文: 太好了！现在解锁「{0}」。它也是免费的。

英文原文: Now it's up to you to choose your path. Start with '{0}' and build rockets, or start with '{1}' and build cars and planes? You only have enough Tech Points for one, so choose wisely!
当前中文: 现在由你来选择路线。从「{0}」开始造火箭，还是从「{1}」开始造汽车和飞机？你的科技点只够选一个，好好考虑！

英文原文: You don't have access to any more technologies for now, so let me show you how to get more Tech Points. Click the back button at the top left to exit the Tech Tree.
当前中文: 你目前无法解锁更多技术，所以我来说明如何获得更多科技点。点击左上角的返回按钮退出科技树。

英文原文: Let's go back to Contracts and accept a contract. It's time to start your career!
当前中文: 我们回到合约界面接受一个合约。该开始你的生涯了！

英文原文: This is where you'll find contracts. Completing them earns the money you need to launch new crafts and unlock better launch locations. Your available funds show at the top of the screen.
当前中文: 这里是查看合约的地方。完成合约可获得资金，用于发射新载具、解锁更好的发射场。你的可用资金显示在屏幕顶部。

英文原文: To use my patents, I need you to prove you deserve them. So I've set up these Milestones. Reaching them earns Tech Points, which you can spend to unlock new technology in the Tech Tree. Your Tech Point total is shown at the top of the screen.
当前中文: 想使用我的专利，你得证明自己配得上它们。所以我设置了这些里程碑。达成里程碑可获得科技点，可用来在科技树中解锁新技术。你的科技点总数显示在屏幕顶部。

英文原文: Here are the landmarks you can visit and additional milestones you can do in each Celestial Body. You can click them to see more details.
当前中文: 这里列出了每个天体可访问的地标和可完成的额外里程碑。你可以点击它们查看更多详情。

英文原文: Here you can find the exploration related milestones. Click on Droo.
当前中文: 这里可以找到与探索相关的里程碑。点击 Droo。

英文原文: Select the {0} contract and then click Start Tutorial to accept this contract and begin a designer tutorial.
当前中文: 选择 {0} 合约，然后点击开始教程以接受该合约并进入设计器教程。

英文原文: Fantastic! I highly recommend doing the tutorial for this contract. Otherwise, click Build in the bottom left to enter the designer and start building your craft. Click Okay and get started! Good luck!
当前中文: 太好了！我强烈建议先做这个合约的教程。否则，点击左下角的建造进入设计器，开始建造你的载具。点击确定开始吧！祝你好运！

英文原文: Would you like to back up your current craft before starting the tutorial?
当前中文: 开始教程前，要备份你当前的载具吗？

英文原文: Welcome to the Designer! First, let me show you how to move the view around.
当前中文: 欢迎来到设计器！首先，我来演示如何移动视角。

英文原文: This is the Command Pod and it's the brain of your rocket. Try to keep it safe. You can't control your rocket without it.
当前中文: 这是指令舱，是你火箭的大脑。尽量保护好它。没有它就无法控制火箭。

英文原文: Before we add a part, let's turn on the Finger Tool. It makes placing parts with precision much easier. It can also help you clone parts, but we'll cover that later.
当前中文: 在添加零件之前，先打开手指工具。它能让精确放置零件容易得多。它还能帮你克隆零件，不过这个稍后再讲。

英文原文: I've started with the car from The Jump tutorial but I've made some tweaks to make room for some wings.
当前中文: 我从「跳跃」教程的汽车开始，做了一些调整，为机翼腾出空间。

英文原文: First, we'll need to add the main wings that will provide the lift to get this beauty off the ground.
当前中文: 首先，我们需要添加主机翼，提供让这个漂亮家伙离开地面的升力。

英文原文: Now, add a control surface to this wing so the craft will be able to roll and turn while flying through the air.
当前中文: 现在给这个机翼添加一个控制面，让载具在空中飞行时能够滚转和转向。

英文原文: Use the Symmetry Tool and duplicate our work to the other side.
当前中文: 使用对称工具，把我们的成果复制到另一侧。

英文原文: Now add the elevator, which will allow the craft to pitch upwards and downwards to change its altitude. It's quite important for airplanes.
当前中文: 现在添加升降舵，它能让载具上下俯仰以改变高度。对飞机来说相当重要。

英文原文: The elevator's control surface should respond to Pitch input. Note to self: the wheels are also set to Pitch, so we'll change those later.
当前中文: 升降舵的控制面应响应俯仰输入。记一下：轮子也设成了俯仰，稍后我们会改掉。

英文原文: Use the Symmetry Tool and duplicate our work to the other side.
当前中文: 使用对称工具，把我们的成果复制到另一侧。

英文原文: Now add the rudder, which provides stability on the yaw axis. It's a common misconception that the rudder is for turning — that's actually the job of the main wings rolling into the turn. The rudder is for minor corrections.
当前中文: 现在添加方向舵，它在偏航轴上提供稳定性。常见误解是方向舵用来转向——实际上那是主机翼滚转的任务。方向舵用于小幅修正。

英文原文: The rudder's control surface should respond to Yaw input.
当前中文: 方向舵的控制面应响应偏航输入。

英文原文: Since the elevators use the Pitch input, we'll change the wheels' motor input to Throttle. Otherwise, pulling back on the stick to pitch up would also decrease the motor input.
当前中文: 由于升降舵使用俯仰输入，我们要把轮子的电机输入改为油门。否则拉杆抬头时也会降低电机输入。

英文原文: When designing an airplane, the relationship between the Center of Mass (CoM) and the Center of Lift (CoL) is very important. We can visualize their positions using the View Panel.
当前中文: 设计飞机时，质心 (CoM) 与升力中心 (CoL) 的关系非常重要。我们可以用视图面板显示它们的位置。

英文原文:
As you can see, the red Center of Mass is slightly in front of the blue Center of Lift, so this craft should be aerodynamically stable. The further the CoM is in front of the CoL, the more stable it becomes, but it loses some maneuverability and pitch response.

The closer they are, the more aerobatic it becomes, but too close and it can turn unstable. CoM behind the CoL would be like trying to shoot an arrow backwards, feathers first.

To simplify: the red ball is in front of the blue ball, so this craft is good to go.
当前中文:
如你所见，红色的质心略在蓝色升力中心之前，所以这架载具在气动上是稳定的。质心越靠前越稳定，但会损失一些机动性和俯仰响应。

两者越接近，机动性越强，但太近就可能变得不稳定。质心在升力中心之后，就像倒着射箭、羽毛朝前。

简单说：红球在蓝球前面，所以这架载具没问题。

英文原文: Great job! Even the Wright Brothers would be proud!
当前中文: 干得漂亮！连莱特兄弟都会为你骄傲！

英文原文: Now launch this magnificent creation from the Juno Village Runway. Let's see if this thing can fly!
当前中文: 现在从村庄跑道发射这件杰作。看看它能不能飞！

英文原文: We have a craft ready for you, but its engines need a few tweaks to improve performance so it can achieve orbit.
当前中文: 我们为你准备了一辆载具，但它的发动机需要微调以提升性能，才能进入轨道。

英文原文: This is the craft's total Delta V, meaning change in velocity. Theoretically, it's how fast the craft could go in a perfect environment with no gravity and no drag.
当前中文: 这是载具的总 Delta-V，即速度变化量。理论上，它是在无重力、无阻力的完美环境中载具能达到的速度。

英文原文: Realistically, we need at least 4,500m/s to reach low orbit around Droo. It looks like we have more than enough, but remember that engine performance is affected by atmospheric pressure, which changes with altitude.
当前中文: 实际上，要进入 Droo 低轨道至少需要 4,500m/s。看起来我们绰绰有余，但记住发动机性能受大气压影响，而大气压随高度变化。

英文原文: We have some work to do. We'll look at each stage to see what we can do to improve performance. Don't worry, it's just rocket science.
当前中文: 我们还有活要干。逐级看看能如何提升性能。别担心，不过是火箭科学而已。

英文原文: Let's look at the first stage, which consists of five solid rocket motors.
当前中文: 先看第一级，它由五台固体火箭发动机构成。

英文原文: The Delta V looks okay for this stage. We just want it to gain some altitude before starting the more efficient engines, which need a thinner atmosphere to work.
当前中文: 这一级的 Delta-V 看起来还行。我们只希望它先获得一定高度，再启动效率更高、需要更稀薄大气才能工作的发动机。

英文原文: Another important metric is TWR, or Thrust to Weight Ratio. If it's less than 1, the craft can't overcome gravity during liftoff. This stage has plenty of TWR for launch.
当前中文: 另一个重要指标是 TWR，即推重比。如果小于 1，载具起飞时无法克服重力。这一级的 TWR 足以发射。

英文原文: Notice the Ending TWR is higher than the Starting TWR. That's because the engines burn fuel mass throughout the stage, so the craft loses mass. This means the rocket's acceleration actually increases throughout the stage.
当前中文: 注意结束 TWR 高于起始 TWR。这是因为整个分级过程中发动机会烧掉燃料质量，载具随之变轻。也就是说火箭的加速度在这一级中会不断增加。

英文原文: One last thing: the Isp, or Specific Impulse. It's kinda like gas mileage for rocket engines, and higher is better. These solid rocket motors aren't very efficient, but they're cheap and get the job done.
当前中文: 最后一点：Isp，即比冲。它有点像火箭发动机的油耗，越高越好。这些固体火箭发动机效率不高，但便宜且能完成任务。

英文原文: Let's look at the second stage. From our previous launches we have found that this stage will ignite around 8km altitude.
当前中文: 看看第二级。根据之前的发射经验，这一级会在约 8km 高度点火。

英文原文: The Delta V and Starting TWR are terrible for this stage. That's because the Gnome Engine is optimized for a vacuum, but don't worry! We can do some rocket surgery here to improve its performance inside an atmosphere.
当前中文: 这一级的 Delta-V 和起始 TWR 都很糟。因为 Gnome 发动机是为真空优化的，但别担心！我们可以给它做点火箭手术，提升它在大气内的性能。

英文原文: This engine is suffering from severe over-expansion, which happens when the exhaust Exit Pressure is below Air Pressure. Over-expansion is what causes shock diamonds in the exhaust. The closer Exit Pressure is to Air Pressure, the more efficient the engine.
当前中文: 这台发动机存在严重的过度膨胀，即排气出口压力低于大气压时发生的情况。过度膨胀会在尾焰中产生激波钻石。出口压力越接近大气压，发动机效率越高。

英文原文: We can shorten the nozzle and crank up the power to raise this engine's Exit Pressure closer to the Air Pressure at this altitude.
当前中文: 我们可以缩短喷管并加大功率，让这台发动机的出口压力更接近此高度的大气压。

英文原文: Let's take a look and see how things have changed.
That's a huge improvement in Delta V and TWR! Now let's take a look at the third stage.
当前中文: Delta-V 和 TWR 提升巨大！现在看看第三级。

英文原文: The third stage engine will mostly be working in the upper atmosphere and in space.
当前中文: 第三级发动机主要在高空和太空中工作。

英文原文: The Delta V is pretty good for this stage, but we can improve it by lengthening the nozzle.
当前中文: 这一级的 Delta-V 已经不错，但我们可以通过加长喷管进一步提升。

英文原文: Ideally, Exit Pressure would be 0 for a rocket engine built to work in space, but that would need an infinitely large nozzle. We'll settle for something a little shorter than that.
当前中文: 理想情况下，为太空工作而造的火箭发动机出口压力应为 0，但那需要无限大的喷管。我们就用比那稍短一些的。

英文原文: Great work! Now this rocket is ready for launch!
当前中文: 干得好！这枚火箭可以发射了！

英文原文: Click the launch button at the top right and launch from the Juno Village Pad.
当前中文: 点击右上角的发射按钮，从村庄发射台发射。

英文原文: Let's start with the same rocket we built for the Vertical Shot contract, minus the nose cone.
当前中文: 我们从为「垂直冲高」合约建造的那枚火箭开始，去掉头锥。

英文原文: First, let's attach the payload. This is what the customer wants us to bring to space, so be careful with it and try not to damage it.
当前中文: 首先，连接载荷。这是客户要我们送上太空的东西，小心别弄坏它。

英文原文: Now, let's add an 'Interstage'. It splits the rocket into multiple 'stages' but more on that later.
当前中文: 现在添加一个「级间段」。它把火箭分成多个「分级」，这个稍后再细说。

英文原文: Now let's add another fuel tank below this, but we will make it a bit fatter so it can hold more fuel.
当前中文: 现在在下面再加一个燃料箱，不过我们会把它加粗一些，好装更多燃料。

英文原文: Now let's connect an engine to this fuel tank.
当前中文: 现在给这个燃料箱连接一台发动机。

英文原文: Now let's duplicate this engine because we need more thrust.
当前中文: 现在复制这台发动机，因为我们需要更大推力。

英文原文: Now let's add some fins to the bottom stage for more stabilization. We can clone the fins from the upper stage to save us some work.
当前中文: 现在给底部分级加几个尾翼以增强稳定性。我们可以克隆上级的尾翼省点事。

英文原文: Staging is normally calculated automatically, but it's a good idea to check it before launching.\n\nThe Second Stage Engine should actually be in Stage 2 so it can activate and do its thing before the payload is deployed.
当前中文: 分级通常会自动计算，但发射前检查一下是个好主意。\n\n第二级发动机其实应该放在分级 2，这样它能在载荷部署前启动并完成工作。

英文原文: Excellent! You have built a multi-stage rocket!
当前中文: 太棒了！你造出了一枚多级火箭！

英文原文: Now click the Launch button and see how it flies.
当前中文: 现在点击发射按钮，看看它飞得怎么样。

英文原文: Great news! We have an airplane for you, all ready to go!
当前中文: 好消息！我们为你准备了一架飞机，随时可以起飞！

英文原文:
These electric motors spin the propellers to generate thrust. They spin in opposite directions so the torque cancels out.

It's very efficient, but also a bit slow. Later, after you unlock jet engines, you'll be able to build much faster airplanes.
当前中文:
这些电动机带动螺旋桨旋转产生推力。它们反向旋转，扭矩相互抵消。

它非常高效，但也偏慢。之后解锁喷气发动机，你就能造出快得多的飞机。

英文原文: Good luck on your first air race!
当前中文: 祝你第一场空中竞速好运！

英文原文: Launch from the Juno Village Runway.
Since we are building a craft that mostly moves horizontally, we'll need to change the Command Disc from Rocket to Plane configuration.
当前中文: 既然我们要造一辆主要水平移动的载具，就需要把指令盘从火箭配置改为飞机配置。

英文原文: Let's also increase the battery capacity, which will increase the driving range of this car.
当前中文: 顺便提高电池容量，这会增加这辆车的行驶里程。

英文原文: Let's start building a car. First, add an empty fuel tank behind the Command Disc. This will serve as the body of the car.
当前中文: 开始造车吧。首先，在指令盘后面添加一个空燃料箱，作为车身。

英文原文: Now let's add a nose cone to help reduce drag and make it look cooler too.
当前中文: 现在添加一个头锥，有助于减小阻力，也更好看。

英文原文: Now let's add a front wheel.
Now let's add a rear wheel
I think cars usually have wheels on both sides, so let's use the Symmetry Tool and duplicate our work to the other side.
当前中文: 汽车通常两侧都有轮子，所以我们用对称工具把成果复制到另一侧。

英文原文: Now do the same thing for the other wheel.
当前中文: 现在对另一个轮子做同样的操作。

英文原文: Make the front wheels turnable and reduce the engine torque to save money.\n\nSince Symmetry Mode is enabled on this wheel, the other side automatically gets any changes we make.
当前中文: 把前轮设为可转向，并降低发动机扭矩以省钱。\n\n由于这个轮子启用了对称模式，我们做的任何更改都会自动应用到另一侧。

英文原文: Crank up the torque on those rear wheels and adjust their gear ratio. Lower gear ratios favor top speed; higher gear ratios favor acceleration.
当前中文: 把后轮的扭矩加大并调整它们的传动比。传动比越低越偏向最高速度，越高越偏向加速。

英文原文: Change the motor input to use Pitch instead of Throttle. This will allow you to go in reverse in case you get stuck.
当前中文: 把电机输入从油门改为俯仰。这样万一卡住，你还能倒车。

英文原文: Excellent! I've never seen a better car! I'm really proud of us!
当前中文: 太棒了！我从没见过更好的车！真为我们感到骄傲！

英文原文: Now click the launch button at the top right and launch this magnificent creation from the Juno Village Runway.
当前中文: 现在点击右上角的发射按钮，从村庄跑道发射这件杰作。

英文原文: Let's build a rocket! The first step is to add a fuel tank below the Command Disc.
当前中文: 来造一枚火箭！第一步是在指令盘下面添加一个燃料箱。

英文原文: Now let's add a nose cone to help reduce drag.
当前中文: 现在添加一个头锥以帮助减小阻力。

英文原文: Now connect an engine to this fuel tank. Engines draw fuel from the fuel tanks directly above them.
当前中文: 现在给这个燃料箱连接一台发动机。发动机从其正上方的燃料箱抽取燃料。

英文原文: Now let's add some fins to help stabilize this beautiful creation.
当前中文: 现在加几个尾翼，帮助这件美丽作品保持稳定。

英文原文: Now we can enable Symmetry Mode on this fin so we can duplicate our work instead of having to add each fin individually.
当前中文: 现在我们可以为这个尾翼启用对称模式，这样就能复制成果，不必逐个添加尾翼。

英文原文: Now let's enable the gyro on the Command Disc. The gyro can help to stabilize the rocket when it's in flight.
当前中文: 现在启用指令盘上的陀螺仪。陀螺仪能在飞行中帮助稳定火箭。

英文原文: Excellent! You have built your first rocket!
当前中文: 太棒了！你造出了自己的第一枚火箭！

英文原文: Click the launch button at the top right and launch from the Juno Village Pad.
当前中文: 点击右上角的发射按钮，从村庄发射台发射。

英文原文: Let's start building. The first step is to add a fuel tank below the Command Pod.
当前中文: 开始建造吧。第一步是在指令舱下面添加一个燃料箱。

英文原文: Now let's connect a small engine to this fuel tank. Engines draw fuel from the fuel tanks directly above them.
当前中文: 现在给这个燃料箱连接一台小型发动机。发动机从其正上方的燃料箱抽取燃料。

英文原文: Now let's connect an 'Interstage'. It splits the rocket into multiple 'stages' but more on that later.
当前中文: 现在连接一个「级间段」。它把火箭分成多个「分级」，这个稍后再细说。

英文原文: Let's add another, larger fuel tank below the Interstage.
当前中文: 在级间段下面再加一个更大的燃料箱。

当前中文: 给这个燃料箱连接一台更强的发动机。
